source_summaries.name: Council for the Regulation of Freight Forwarding in Nigeria membership requirements
CRFFN freight-forwarding and supply-chain professional pathway
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian freight forwarding, cargo clearance and supply-chain practice
findings: CRFFN regulates and sets competence standards for freight forwarding in Nigeria.
The council describes Certificate in Freight Forwarding, FIATA Diploma and Higher Diploma pathways and accredited training providers.
source_summaries.limitations: The professional pathway applies to freight-forwarding practice; it is not a universal credential requirement for every warehouse, transport or supply-chain role.

source_summaries.name: Federal Road Safety Corps Driving School Standardization Programme and instructor standards
Jobberman Nigeria jobs
Jobberman Nigeria supply-chain and procurement job-search snapshot
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria supply-chain and procurement listings
findings: The page reported 79 available jobs, with listings including procurement officer, inventory officer, storekeeper, warehouse, logistics and supply-chain roles.
The snapshot showed a strong Lagos concentration and roles spanning entry, mid and senior levels.
source_summaries.limitations: Job-board counts and listings are time-bound, may contain duplicates and are not a national labour-force estimate.

source_summaries.name: MyJobMag Nigeria feeds
MyJobMag Nigeria supply-chain role and skills snapshot
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria supply-chain administrator, manager and logistics listings
findings: Listings describe planning, sourcing, procurement coordination, inventory optimisation, warehousing, logistics documentation, customs clearing and supplier management.
A listing example names Excel and SAP MM as tools used in supply-chain work.
source_summaries.limitations: The page is a selective job-board snapshot and does not establish universal tool requirements.

source_summaries.name: National Bureau of Statistics Nigeria Labour Force Survey
Nigerian creative-media and performing-production standards
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian film and media production, cinematography, lighting, sound, editing, production design, performance, special effects and stage/creative production
findings: The Nigerian NBTE Creative Media Production standard covers storytelling, cinematography, sound, production design, editing, performance, special effects, video-camera operation, lighting and casting; National Theatre materials identify stage performances, film shows, exhibitions, cultural shows, circus shows and related production facilities.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources establish Nigerian training and production ecosystems, not a national vacancy count or direct evidence for every highly specialised performance title; role-specific gaps remain explicit where the source does not support the title.

source_summaries.name: NBTE National Occupational Standards and National Skills Qualifications brochure, January 2026 edition
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian occupational and skills pathways across agriculture, animal husbandry, engineering, construction, ICT, fashion, hospitality, health and safety
findings: The brochure lists Nigerian NOS/NSQ pathways including aquaculture, crop production, animal husbandry, industrial automation, solar photovoltaic systems, welding and fabrication, garment making, food and beverage service, artificial intelligence, backend web development, cloud security engineering and other trades.
source_summaries.limitations: A listed NOS/NSQ is evidence that a Nigerian training standard exists; it is not proof that every employer requires it or that every canonical role maps one-to-one to the trade title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian Civil Aviation Authority air transport licensing and certification
Nigeria Customs Service Authorised Economic Operator programme
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian importers, exporters, customs brokers, freight forwarders, transport and logistics operators
findings: The AEO material describes compliance, record management, customs knowledge, risk education, secure information exchange and supply-chain security for participating trade operators; the 2025 newsletter references the Nigeria Customs Service Act 2023 legal basis and ISO 28001 for the security tier.
source_summaries.limitations: AEO is an organisation/operator programme and does not make every listed control a personal certificate for every logistics or customs role.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian Export Promotion Council logistics and freight guidance
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian export logistics, freight forwarding, warehousing and Incoterms
findings: NEPC guidance identifies transport modes, shipment conditions, freight forwarding, warehousing and Incoterms as practical export-logistics knowledge.
source_summaries.limitations: Export guidance is sector context and does not create an individual certification or vacancy claim.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian energy planning, efficiency and sustainable-energy context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian energy policy, planning, statistics, renewable energy, energy efficiency, electricity, fossil fuels and sustainable-energy development
findings: The Energy Commission of Nigeria identifies national energy planning and policy implementation, energy statistics, energy information systems, electricity and fossil-fuel functions, renewable-energy research and energy-efficiency or sustainable-development work.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian energy-sector and planning context, not a universal building-assessor licence, project-vacancy count or qualification for every hydropower, pipeline, energy or conservation title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian hospitality, catering, travel and tourism training and regulation context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian hotels, restaurants, catering, accommodation, front office, housekeeping, food and beverage, travel, tours, events, recreation, tourism promotion and hospitality standards
findings: The Federal Ministry describes NIHOTOUR as Nigeria's hospitality and tourism training arm with professional and technical programmes; NTDA describes national tourism development, regulation, promotion, capacity building and accreditation of hotels, restaurants, travel agencies, tour operators and related enterprises; official sector sources identify hotel, catering, recreation, tourism safety and tourism-ethics functions.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources establish Nigerian hospitality and tourism role-family context, not a vacancy count or a universal certification for every service, food, travel or entertainment title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian inland-waterway transport, marine safety and operations context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian inland-waterway navigation, vessel operations, cargo handling, warehousing, ferry services, pilotage, safety inspection, traffic management, maritime security and intermodal transport
findings: NIWA describes statutory Nigerian responsibility for inland-waterway development and regulation, vessel operations, ferry services, cargo handling, storage, stevedoring, pilotage, vessel traffic management, safety inspections, search and rescue and maritime security; it also describes training for boat operators and skippers.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian inland-waterway role and operational context; it does not establish a counterpart for every air, rail, pipeline or ocean-shipping title, or one universal licence for every waterway role.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian petroleum operations, process safety and workforce competency context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian upstream, midstream and downstream petroleum operations, control-room work, pipeline and facility safety, competent-person training and permits
findings: NUPRC publishes Nigerian upstream regulations and facility guidelines requiring competent persons, training, safe work procedures and records.
NMDPRA publishes downstream guidelines and MISTDO safety training requirements for downstream personnel.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian petroleum operations and safety context; it does not establish a vacancy count or one credential for every operator, technician, contractor or manager title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian rail, airport, airspace and transport-operations context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian railway stations, rail operations, train safety, signalling, route planning, airport operations, baggage, airspace and air-transport services, aviation fuel and road-transport administration
findings: NRC describes passenger and goods carriage, station management, train safety, control and signalling, route planning, traffic and commercial operations; NCAA regulates air transport, aviation fuel and aerodrome services; FAAN manages Nigerian commercial airports, airport operations, cargo and passenger services; NAMA describes air-traffic-management, communications, navigation and surveillance; the Federal Ministry of Transportation lists rail, road, engineering and transport-planning functions.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources establish Nigerian rail, airport, airspace and transport-operation context, not a vacancy count or a counterpart for every global vehicle, pipeline, event, warehouse or specialist infrastructure title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian road-driver licensing, commercial transport and road-safety context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian commercial and private driving, road transport, delivery, passenger services, dangerous goods, vehicle inspection, driver licensing and road safety
findings: The Federal Ministry of Transportation identifies road transport and mass-transit administration, driver licensing and vehicle inspection; the FRSC driver-licence service documents licensing and commercial-licence routes; FRSC materials address safe operation of articulated vehicles and dangerous-goods transport.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources establish Nigerian road-driver and road-transport context, not a vacancy count or a universal licence category for every specialist vehicle, emergency, aviation, rail or private-driving title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian procurement, freight and supply-chain professional context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian procurement, purchasing, stores, logistics, supply-chain management, freight forwarding, cargo and professional capacity
findings: CIPSMN identifies procurement, stores, purchasing, supply, logistics and supply-chain management professionals across public and private sectors and describes Nigerian professional certification and training; CRFFN regulates freight forwarding and promotes competence, conduct and supply-chain capacity in Nigeria.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources establish Nigerian professional and regulatory pathways; they do not establish one universal certificate or current demand ranking for every procurement, logistics or supply-chain role.

source_summaries.name: NIMASA approved maritime training and STCW-aligned courses
NIMASA seafarer education, training, certification and medical-fitness standards
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian seafarer education, assessment, certification, revalidation, endorsement and medical fitness
findings: NIMASA reported revised standards under Nigeria's 2025 STCW regulations, including education, training, assessment, examination, certification, revalidation, endorsement and medical-fitness requirements, with bridging courses for specified ND/HND holders.
source_summaries.limitations: These standards apply to seafarer roles and do not apply to every maritime, port, logistics or naval-architecture occupation.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria Institute of Transport Technology logistics training calendar
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian transport, supply-chain and logistics training
findings: The training calendar includes fundamentals of supply-chain management and cold-chain logistics management.
source_summaries.limitations: Training-course availability is not proof of a role requirement or employment demand.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian hospitality, catering, travel and tourism training and regulation context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian hotels, restaurants, catering, accommodation, front office, housekeeping, food and beverage, travel, tours, events, recreation, tourism promotion and hospitality standards
findings: The Federal Ministry describes NIHOTOUR as Nigeria's hospitality and tourism training arm with professional and technical programmes; NTDA describes national tourism development, regulation, promotion, capacity building and accreditation of hotels, restaurants, travel agencies, tour operators and related enterprises; official sector sources identify hotel, catering, recreation, tourism safety and tourism-ethics functions.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources establish Nigerian hospitality and tourism role-family context, not a vacancy count or a universal certification for every service, food, travel or entertainment title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian inland-waterway transport, marine safety and operations context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian inland-waterway navigation, vessel operations, cargo handling, warehousing, ferry services, pilotage, safety inspection, traffic management, maritime security and intermodal transport
findings: NIWA describes statutory Nigerian responsibility for inland-waterway development and regulation, vessel operations, ferry services, cargo handling, storage, stevedoring, pilotage, vessel traffic management, safety inspections, search and rescue and maritime security; it also describes training for boat operators and skippers.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian inland-waterway role and operational context; it does not establish a counterpart for every air, rail, pipeline or ocean-shipping title, or one universal licence for every waterway role.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian petroleum operations, process safety and workforce competency context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian upstream, midstream and downstream petroleum operations, control-room work, pipeline and facility safety, competent-person training and permits
findings: NUPRC publishes Nigerian upstream regulations and facility guidelines requiring competent persons, training, safe work procedures and records.
NMDPRA publishes downstream guidelines and MISTDO safety training requirements for downstream personnel.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian petroleum operations and safety context; it does not establish a vacancy count or one credential for every operator, technician, contractor or manager title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian rail, airport, airspace and transport-operations context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian railway stations, rail operations, train safety, signalling, route planning, airport operations, baggage, airspace and air-transport services, aviation fuel and road-transport administration
findings: NRC describes passenger and goods carriage, station management, train safety, control and signalling, route planning, traffic and commercial operations; NCAA regulates air transport, aviation fuel and aerodrome services; FAAN manages Nigerian commercial airports, airport operations, cargo and passenger services; NAMA describes air-traffic-management, communications, navigation and surveillance; the Federal Ministry of Transportation lists rail, road, engineering and transport-planning functions.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources establish Nigerian rail, airport, airspace and transport-operation context, not a vacancy count or a counterpart for every global vehicle, pipeline, event, warehouse or specialist infrastructure title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian road-driver licensing, commercial transport and road-safety context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian commercial and private driving, road transport, delivery, passenger services, dangerous goods, vehicle inspection, driver licensing and road safety
findings: The Federal Ministry of Transportation identifies road transport and mass-transit administration, driver licensing and vehicle inspection; the FRSC driver-licence service documents licensing and commercial-licence routes; FRSC materials address safe operation of articulated vehicles and dangerous-goods transport.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources establish Nigerian road-driver and road-transport context, not a vacancy count or a universal licence category for every specialist vehicle, emergency, aviation, rail or private-driving title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian procurement, freight and supply-chain professional context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian procurement, purchasing, stores, logistics, supply-chain management, freight forwarding, cargo and professional capacity
findings: CIPSMN identifies procurement, stores, purchasing, supply, logistics and supply-chain management professionals across public and private sectors and describes Nigerian professional certification and training; CRFFN regulates freight forwarding and promotes competence, conduct and supply-chain capacity in Nigeria.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources establish Nigerian professional and regulatory pathways; they do not establish one universal certificate or current demand ranking for every procurement, logistics or supply-chain role.

source_summaries.name: NIMASA approved maritime training and STCW-aligned courses
NIMASA seafarer education, training, certification and medical-fitness standards
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian seafarer education, assessment, certification, revalidation, endorsement and medical fitness
findings: NIMASA reported revised standards under Nigeria's 2025 STCW regulations, including education, training, assessment, examination, certification, revalidation, endorsement and medical-fitness requirements, with bridging courses for specified ND/HND holders.
source_summaries.limitations: These standards apply to seafarer roles and do not apply to every maritime, port, logistics or naval-architecture occupation.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria Institute of Transport Technology logistics training calendar
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian transport, supply-chain and logistics training
findings: The training calendar includes fundamentals of supply-chain management and cold-chain logistics management.
source_summaries.limitations: Training-course availability is not proof of a role requirement or employment demand.

source_summaries.scope: Nigerian upstream, midstream and downstream petroleum operations, control-room work, pipeline and facility safety, competent-person training and permits
findings: NUPRC publishes Nigerian upstream regulations and facility guidelines requiring competent persons, training, safe work procedures and records.
NMDPRA publishes downstream guidelines and MISTDO safety training requirements for downstream personnel.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian petroleum operations and safety context; it does not establish a vacancy count or one credential for every operator, technician, contractor or manager title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian rail, airport, airspace and transport-operations context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian railway stations, rail operations, train safety, signalling, route planning, airport operations, baggage, airspace and air-transport services, aviation fuel and road-transport administration
findings: NRC describes passenger and goods carriage, station management, train safety, control and signalling, route planning, traffic and commercial operations; NCAA regulates air transport, aviation fuel and aerodrome services; FAAN manages Nigerian commercial airports, airport operations, cargo and passenger services; NAMA describes air-traffic-management, communications, navigation and surveillance; the Federal Ministry of Transportation lists rail, road, engineering and transport-planning functions.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources establish Nigerian rail, airport, airspace and transport-operation context, not a vacancy count or a counterpart for every global vehicle, pipeline, event, warehouse or specialist infrastructure title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian road-driver licensing, commercial transport and road-safety context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian commercial and private driving, road transport, delivery, passenger services, dangerous goods, vehicle inspection, driver licensing and road safety
findings: The Federal Ministry of Transportation identifies road transport and mass-transit administration, driver licensing and vehicle inspection; the FRSC driver-licence service documents licensing and commercial-licence routes; FRSC materials address safe operation of articulated vehicles and dangerous-goods transport.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources establish Nigerian road-driver and road-transport context, not a vacancy count or a universal licence category for every specialist vehicle, emergency, aviation, rail or private-driving title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian procurement, freight and supply-chain professional context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian procurement, purchasing, stores, logistics, supply-chain management, freight forwarding, cargo and professional capacity
findings: CIPSMN identifies procurement, stores, purchasing, supply, logistics and supply-chain management professionals across public and private sectors and describes Nigerian professional certification and training; CRFFN regulates freight forwarding and promotes competence, conduct and supply-chain capacity in Nigeria.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources establish Nigerian professional and regulatory pathways; they do not establish one universal certificate or current demand ranking for every procurement, logistics or supply-chain role.

source_summaries.name: NIMASA approved maritime training and STCW-aligned courses
NIMASA seafarer education, training, certification and medical-fitness standards
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian seafarer education, assessment, certification, revalidation, endorsement and medical fitness
findings: NIMASA reported revised standards under Nigeria's 2025 STCW regulations, including education, training, assessment, examination, certification, revalidation, endorsement and medical-fitness requirements, with bridging courses for specified ND/HND holders.
source_summaries.limitations: These standards apply to seafarer roles and do not apply to every maritime, port, logistics or naval-architecture occupation.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria Institute of Transport Technology logistics training calendar
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian transport, supply-chain and logistics training
findings: The training calendar includes fundamentals of supply-chain management and cold-chain logistics management.
source_summaries.limitations: Training-course availability is not proof of a role requirement or employment demand.

findings: The brochure lists Nigerian NOS/NSQ pathways including aquaculture, crop production, animal husbandry, industrial automation, solar photovoltaic systems, welding and fabrication, garment making, food and beverage service, artificial intelligence, backend web development, cloud security engineering and other trades.
source_summaries.limitations: A listed NOS/NSQ is evidence that a Nigerian training standard exists; it is not proof that every employer requires it or that every canonical role maps one-to-one to the trade title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian Civil Aviation Authority air transport licensing and certification
Nigeria Customs Service Authorised Economic Operator programme
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian importers, exporters, customs brokers, freight forwarders, transport and logistics operators
findings: The AEO material describes compliance, record management, customs knowledge, risk education, secure information exchange and supply-chain security for participating trade operators; the 2025 newsletter references the Nigeria Customs Service Act 2023 legal basis and ISO 28001 for the security tier.
source_summaries.limitations: AEO is an organisation/operator programme and does not make every listed control a personal certificate for every logistics or customs role.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian Export Promotion Council logistics and freight guidance
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian export logistics, freight forwarding, warehousing and Incoterms
findings: NEPC guidance identifies transport modes, shipment conditions, freight forwarding, warehousing and Incoterms as practical export-logistics knowledge.
source_summaries.limitations: Export guidance is sector context and does not create an individual certification or vacancy claim.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian energy planning, efficiency and sustainable-energy context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian energy policy, planning, statistics, renewable energy, energy efficiency, electricity, fossil fuels and sustainable-energy development
findings: The Energy Commission of Nigeria identifies national energy planning and policy implementation, energy statistics, energy information systems, electricity and fossil-fuel functions, renewable-energy research and energy-efficiency or sustainable-development work.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian energy-sector and planning context, not a universal building-assessor licence, project-vacancy count or qualification for every hydropower, pipeline, energy or conservation title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian hospitality, catering, travel and tourism training and regulation context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian hotels, restaurants, catering, accommodation, front office, housekeeping, food and beverage, travel, tours, events, recreation, tourism promotion and hospitality standards
findings: The Federal Ministry describes NIHOTOUR as Nigeria's hospitality and tourism training arm with professional and technical programmes; NTDA describes national tourism development, regulation, promotion, capacity building and accreditation of hotels, restaurants, travel agencies, tour operators and related enterprises; official sector sources identify hotel, catering, recreation, tourism safety and tourism-ethics functions.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources establish Nigerian hospitality and tourism role-family context, not a vacancy count or a universal certification for every service, food, travel or entertainment title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian inland-waterway transport, marine safety and operations context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian inland-waterway navigation, vessel operations, cargo handling, warehousing, ferry services, pilotage, safety inspection, traffic management, maritime security and intermodal transport
findings: NIWA describes statutory Nigerian responsibility for inland-waterway development and regulation, vessel operations, ferry services, cargo handling, storage, stevedoring, pilotage, vessel traffic management, safety inspections, search and rescue and maritime security; it also describes training for boat operators and skippers.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian inland-waterway role and operational context; it does not establish a counterpart for every air, rail, pipeline or ocean-shipping title, or one universal licence for every waterway role.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian petroleum operations, process safety and workforce competency context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian upstream, midstream and downstream petroleum operations, control-room work, pipeline and facility safety, competent-person training and permits
findings: NUPRC publishes Nigerian upstream regulations and facility guidelines requiring competent persons, training, safe work procedures and records.
NMDPRA publishes downstream guidelines and MISTDO safety training requirements for downstream personnel.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian petroleum operations and safety context; it does not establish a vacancy count or one credential for every operator, technician, contractor or manager title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian rail, airport, airspace and transport-operations context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian railway stations, rail operations, train safety, signalling, route planning, airport operations, baggage, airspace and air-transport services, aviation fuel and road-transport administration
findings: NRC describes passenger and goods carriage, station management, train safety, control and signalling, route planning, traffic and commercial operations; NCAA regulates air transport, aviation fuel and aerodrome services; FAAN manages Nigerian commercial airports, airport operations, cargo and passenger services; NAMA describes air-traffic-management, communications, navigation and surveillance; the Federal Ministry of Transportation lists rail, road, engineering and transport-planning functions.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources establish Nigerian rail, airport, airspace and transport-operation context, not a vacancy count or a counterpart for every global vehicle, pipeline, event, warehouse or specialist infrastructure title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian road-driver licensing, commercial transport and road-safety context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian commercial and private driving, road transport, delivery, passenger services, dangerous goods, vehicle inspection, driver licensing and road safety
findings: The Federal Ministry of Transportation identifies road transport and mass-transit administration, driver licensing and vehicle inspection; the FRSC driver-licence service documents licensing and commercial-licence routes; FRSC materials address safe operation of articulated vehicles and dangerous-goods transport.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources establish Nigerian road-driver and road-transport context, not a vacancy count or a universal licence category for every specialist vehicle, emergency, aviation, rail or private-driving title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian procurement, freight and supply-chain professional context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian procurement, purchasing, stores, logistics, supply-chain management, freight forwarding, cargo and professional capacity
findings: CIPSMN identifies procurement, stores, purchasing, supply, logistics and supply-chain management professionals across public and private sectors and describes Nigerian professional certification and training; CRFFN regulates freight forwarding and promotes competence, conduct and supply-chain capacity in Nigeria.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources establish Nigerian professional and regulatory pathways; they do not establish one universal certificate or current demand ranking for every procurement, logistics or supply-chain role.

source_summaries.name: NIMASA approved maritime training and STCW-aligned courses
NIMASA seafarer education, training, certification and medical-fitness standards
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian seafarer education, assessment, certification, revalidation, endorsement and medical fitness
findings: NIMASA reported revised standards under Nigeria's 2025 STCW regulations, including education, training, assessment, examination, certification, revalidation, endorsement and medical-fitness requirements, with bridging courses for specified ND/HND holders.
source_summaries.limitations: These standards apply to seafarer roles and do not apply to every maritime, port, logistics or naval-architecture occupation.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria Institute of Transport Technology logistics training calendar
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian transport, supply-chain and logistics training
findings: The training calendar includes fundamentals of supply-chain management and cold-chain logistics management.
source_summaries.limitations: Training-course availability is not proof of a role requirement or employment demand.

source_summaries.scope: Nigeria supply-chain and procurement listings
findings: The page reported 79 available jobs, with listings including procurement officer, inventory officer, storekeeper, warehouse, logistics and supply-chain roles.
The snapshot showed a strong Lagos concentration and roles spanning entry, mid and senior levels.

source_summaries.name: MyJobMag Nigeria feeds
Nigeria business-analyst vacancy signals
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria-based business-analysis and operational analytics work
findings: Nigeria-focused MyJobMag pages identify Business Analyst vacancies, including an analyst role in Lagos supporting business objectives, analysis, testing and solution delivery.
source_summaries.limitations: These are vacancy and title signals, not a national demand count, universal qualification requirement or evidence that every business-analyst speciality uses the same tools.

source_summaries.name: MyJobMag Nigeria supply-chain role and skills snapshot
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria supply-chain administrator, manager and logistics listings
findings: Listings describe planning, sourcing, procurement coordination, inventory optimisation, warehousing, logistics documentation, customs clearing and supplier management.
A listing example names Excel and SAP MM as tools used in supply-chain work.
source_summaries.limitations: The page is a selective job-board snapshot and does not establish universal tool requirements.

source_summaries.name: National Bureau of Statistics Nigeria Labour Force Survey
NBTE National Occupational Standards and National Skills Qualifications brochure, January 2026 edition
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian occupational and skills pathways across agriculture, animal husbandry, engineering, construction, ICT, fashion, hospitality, health and safety
findings: The brochure lists Nigerian NOS/NSQ pathways including aquaculture, crop production, animal husbandry, industrial automation, solar photovoltaic systems, welding and fabrication, garment making, food and beverage service, artificial intelligence, backend web development, cloud security engineering and other trades.
source_summaries.limitations: A listed NOS/NSQ is evidence that a Nigerian training standard exists; it is not proof that every employer requires it or that every canonical role maps one-to-one to the trade title.

source_summaries.name: National Electronic Labour Exchange Nigerian customer-service and administrative vacancy
Nigerian customs, tariff, trade facilitation and border-compliance context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian customs clearance, tariff and valuation, import/export documentation, trade facilitation, authorised economic operators, enforcement, border security and customs digital systems
findings: Nigeria Customs Service identifies revenue collection, trade facilitation, border security, enforcement, compliance and digital customs services as core functions.
The Nigeria Trade Portal exposes tariff search, trader guidance, manifests, declarations, licences, permits and a single-window workflow for trade actors.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian customs and trade-work context; it does not establish a vacancy count, one customs-agent licence or the requirements for every import, export, logistics or policy title.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria procurement and purchasing vacancy signals
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria-based procurement, purchasing, sourcing, supplier, contract and supply-chain work
findings: Nigeria-focused vacancy pages identify Procurement Manager and Purchasing Manager roles across agriculture, oil and gas, manufacturing, construction, hospitality, pharmaceuticals and other sectors, with sourcing, vendor management, negotiation and supply-chain responsibilities.
source_summaries.limitations: The listings demonstrate a local procurement role family; they do not establish one universal certification, procurement system, sector requirement or national demand total.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria warehouse, logistics and supply-chain vacancy signals
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria-based warehouse management, inventory, logistics, fulfilment and end-to-end supply-chain operations
findings: Nigeria-focused listings identify Warehouse Manager, Logistics Manager, Warehouse/Logistics Manager, Inventory Manager and Operations & Supply Chain Manager work involving receiving, storage, fulfilment, dispatch, inventory accuracy, warehousing and last-mile delivery.
source_summaries.limitations: The listings demonstrate Nigerian warehouse and logistics role families; they do not establish one universal warehouse system, qualification, salary or demand total.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian procurement, freight and supply-chain professional context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian procurement, purchasing, stores, logistics, supply-chain management, freight forwarding, cargo and professional capacity
findings: CIPSMN identifies procurement, stores, purchasing, supply, logistics and supply-chain management professionals across public and private sectors and describes Nigerian professional certification and training; CRFFN regulates freight forwarding and promotes competence, conduct and supply-chain capacity in Nigeria.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources establish Nigerian professional and regulatory pathways; they do not establish one universal certificate or current demand ranking for every procurement, logistics or supply-chain role.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian aviation and maritime authorities
Council for the Regulation of Freight Forwarding in Nigeria membership requirements
CRFFN freight-forwarding and supply-chain professional pathway
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian freight forwarding, cargo clearance and supply-chain practice
findings: CRFFN regulates and sets competence standards for freight forwarding in Nigeria.
The council describes Certificate in Freight Forwarding, FIATA Diploma and Higher Diploma pathways and accredited training providers.
source_summaries.limitations: The professional pathway applies to freight-forwarding practice; it is not a universal credential requirement for every warehouse, transport or supply-chain role.

source_summaries.name: Federal Ministry of Marine and Blue Economy maritime-sector context
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria maritime regulation, port and blue-economy capacity
findings: The ministry identifies maritime operations, port-facility security and blue-economy job creation as national priorities.
source_summaries.limitations: Sector policy context is not a role-level vacancy count or personal certification requirement.

source_summaries.name: Jobberman Nigeria jobs
Jobberman Nigeria supply-chain and procurement job-search snapshot
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria supply-chain and procurement listings
findings: The page reported 79 available jobs, with listings including procurement officer, inventory officer, storekeeper, warehouse, logistics and supply-chain roles.
The snapshot showed a strong Lagos concentration and roles spanning entry, mid and senior levels.
source_summaries.limitations: Job-board counts and listings are time-bound, may contain duplicates and are not a national labour-force estimate.

source_summaries.name: Maritime Academy of Nigeria nautical and marine-engineering pathways
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian nautical science, marine engineering, hydrography, port and seafarer training
findings: The Academy describes ND/HND Nautical Science and Marine Engineering and professional courses in maritime safety and seafarer operations.
Its programmes combine academic, laboratory, simulator, safety and practical sea-service preparation.
source_summaries.limitations: Education and training pathways do not guarantee employment or substitute for the exact certificate required for a regulated duty.

source_summaries.name: MyJobMag Nigeria feeds
MyJobMag Nigeria supply-chain role and skills snapshot
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria supply-chain administrator, manager and logistics listings
findings: Listings describe planning, sourcing, procurement coordination, inventory optimisation, warehousing, logistics documentation, customs clearing and supplier management.
A listing example names Excel and SAP MM as tools used in supply-chain work.
source_summaries.limitations: The page is a selective job-board snapshot and does not establish universal tool requirements.

source_summaries.name: National Bureau of Statistics Nigeria Labour Force Survey
NBTE National Occupational Standards and National Skills Qualifications brochure, January 2026 edition
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian occupational and skills pathways across agriculture, animal husbandry, engineering, construction, ICT, fashion, hospitality, health and safety
findings: The brochure lists Nigerian NOS/NSQ pathways including aquaculture, crop production, animal husbandry, industrial automation, solar photovoltaic systems, welding and fabrication, garment making, food and beverage service, artificial intelligence, backend web development, cloud security engineering and other trades.
source_summaries.limitations: A listed NOS/NSQ is evidence that a Nigerian training standard exists; it is not proof that every employer requires it or that every canonical role maps one-to-one to the trade title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian Civil Aviation Authority air transport licensing and certification
Nigerian Export Promotion Council logistics and freight guidance
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian export logistics, freight forwarding, warehousing and Incoterms
findings: NEPC guidance identifies transport modes, shipment conditions, freight forwarding, warehousing and Incoterms as practical export-logistics knowledge.
source_summaries.limitations: Export guidance is sector context and does not create an individual certification or vacancy claim.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian inland-waterway transport, marine safety and operations context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian inland-waterway navigation, vessel operations, cargo handling, warehousing, ferry services, pilotage, safety inspection, traffic management, maritime security and intermodal transport
findings: NIWA describes statutory Nigerian responsibility for inland-waterway development and regulation, vessel operations, ferry services, cargo handling, storage, stevedoring, pilotage, vessel traffic management, safety inspections, search and rescue and maritime security; it also describes training for boat operators and skippers.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian inland-waterway role and operational context; it does not establish a counterpart for every air, rail, pipeline or ocean-shipping title, or one universal licence for every waterway role.

source_summaries.name: NIMASA approved maritime training and STCW-aligned courses
NIMASA seafarer qualification, certification and career progression framework
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian seafarer deck, engine, electro-technical and domestic maritime pathways
findings: NIMASA lists Master/Chief Mate, Officer in Charge of a Navigational Watch, Able Seafarer Deck, Chief and Second Engineer, Engineering Watch, Electro-Technical Officer and domestic certificates such as River Master, Quarter Master, Marine Engineer Assistant, Coxswain and Motorman.
The framework combines approved education, practical training, sea service and competency certification.
source_summaries.limitations: Certificate-of-competency requirements apply to the relevant seafaring duties; they are not a universal requirement for shore-based maritime work.

source_summaries.name: NIMASA seafarer education, training, certification and medical-fitness standards
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian seafarer education, assessment, certification, revalidation, endorsement and medical fitness
findings: NIMASA reported revised standards under Nigeria's 2025 STCW regulations, including education, training, assessment, examination, certification, revalidation, endorsement and medical-fitness requirements, with bridging courses for specified ND/HND holders.
source_summaries.limitations: These standards apply to seafarer roles and do not apply to every maritime, port, logistics or naval-architecture occupation.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria Institute of Transport Technology logistics training calendar
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian transport, supply-chain and logistics training
findings: The training calendar includes fundamentals of supply-chain management and cold-chain logistics management.
source_summaries.limitations: Training-course availability is not proof of a role requirement or employment demand.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian commercial diving and underwater technology training context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian commercial diving, underwater technology, offshore safety, SCUBA and competence-based diver training linked to maritime and petroleum-sector work
findings: FUPRE describes diving and underwater-technology competence training and PTI lists commercial-diving-related entry requirements and technical certificate pathways.
source_summaries.limitations: Diving certification depends on the class, depth, equipment, medical fitness, employer and offshore or inshore duty; no single universal Nigerian diver credential is asserted.

source_summaries.scope: Nigeria-based procurement, purchasing, sourcing, supplier, contract and supply-chain work
findings: Nigeria-focused vacancy pages identify Procurement Manager and Purchasing Manager roles across agriculture, oil and gas, manufacturing, construction, hospitality, pharmaceuticals and other sectors, with sourcing, vendor management, negotiation and supply-chain responsibilities.
source_summaries.limitations: The listings demonstrate a local procurement role family; they do not establish one universal certification, procurement system, sector requirement or national demand total.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian textile, garment and trade value-chain context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian textile and garment production, wholesale trade, import/export documentation, customs and local-content value chains
findings: CBN describes a Nigerian cotton, textile and garment value-chain resuscitation initiative, while the Nigeria Trade Portal provides textile and garment trader procedures, customs, certificates and cross-border documentation.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes a Nigerian textile-trade context; it does not establish a vacancy count or imply that every wholesale trader needs the same permit or credential.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria warehouse, logistics and supply-chain vacancy signals
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria-based warehouse management, inventory, logistics, fulfilment and end-to-end supply-chain operations
findings: Nigeria-focused listings identify Warehouse Manager, Logistics Manager, Warehouse/Logistics Manager, Inventory Manager and Operations & Supply Chain Manager work involving receiving, storage, fulfilment, dispatch, inventory accuracy, warehousing and last-mile delivery.
source_summaries.limitations: The listings demonstrate Nigerian warehouse and logistics role families; they do not establish one universal warehouse system, qualification, salary or demand total.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian project-management professional and regulatory pathways
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian project management, PMO, programme delivery, project consulting, professional development, certification and practice standards
findings: PMI Nigeria describes a Nigerian project-management professional community, learning, job and networking pathways; CIPMN describes Nigerian training, examination, certification, licensing, supervision and standards for project managers and PMO or consulting practitioners.
source_summaries.limitations: The bodies establish professional and training pathways, not a national vacancy count or a universal requirement that every project or programme worker hold a particular credential.

source_summaries.name: NIMASA port-state and marine inspection context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian port-state control, marine surveying, ship inspection, cargo-related safety documentation and maritime compliance
findings: NIMASA describes port-state-control inspections, marine surveyors boarding ships, checking certificates and documentation, examining vessels and crews, recording deficiencies and applying Nigerian and IMO-aligned inspection procedures.
source_summaries.limitations: The source supports a Nigerian marine and port-inspection function that is adjacent to the canonical marine cargo inspector title; it does not establish one universal job title, vacancy count or personal certification requirement for every cargo-inspection role.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria Institute of Transport Technology logistics training calendar
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian transport, supply-chain and logistics training
findings: The training calendar includes fundamentals of supply-chain management and cold-chain logistics management.
source_summaries.limitations: Training-course availability is not proof of a role requirement or employment demand.

source_summaries.name: Jobberman Nigeria supply-chain and procurement job-search snapshot

source_summaries.limitations: Job-board counts and listings are time-bound, may contain duplicates and are not a national labour-force estimate.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria Customs Service Authorised Economic Operator programme
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian importers, exporters, customs brokers, freight forwarders, transport and logistics operators
findings: The AEO material describes compliance, record management, customs knowledge, risk education, secure information exchange and supply-chain security for participating trade operators; the 2025 newsletter references the Nigeria Customs Service Act 2023 legal basis and ISO 28001 for the security tier.
source_summaries.limitations: AEO is an organisation/operator programme and does not make every listed control a personal certificate for every logistics or customs role.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria Customs Service recruitment and cadre context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian Customs Service officer recruitment, cadres, revenue, border and anti-smuggling functions
findings: The Nigeria Customs Service recruitment portal describes Superintendent, Inspectorate and Customs Assistant cadres and identifies revenue collection, trade and anti-smuggling functions; an official 2025 update reported 3,927 declared vacancies across those cadres.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes an official Nigerian Customs pathway and service context, not a current open vacancy, guaranteed appointment or one universal qualification for every customs-related role.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian Export Promotion Council logistics and freight guidance
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian export logistics, freight forwarding, warehousing and Incoterms
findings: NEPC guidance identifies transport modes, shipment conditions, freight forwarding, warehousing and Incoterms as practical export-logistics knowledge.
source_summaries.limitations: Export guidance is sector context and does not create an individual certification or vacancy claim.

source_summaries.scope: Nigerian customs clearance, tariff and valuation, import/export documentation, trade facilitation, authorised economic operators, enforcement, border security and customs digital systems

The Nigeria Trade Portal exposes tariff search, trader guidance, manifests, declarations, licences, permits and a single-window workflow for trade actors.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian customs and trade-work context; it does not establish a vacancy count, one customs-agent licence or the requirements for every import, export, logistics or policy title.

NBTE National Occupational Standards and National Skills Qualifications brochure, January 2026 edition
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian occupational and skills pathways across agriculture, animal husbandry, engineering, construction, ICT, fashion, hospitality, health and safety
findings: The brochure lists Nigerian NOS/NSQ pathways including aquaculture, crop production, animal husbandry, industrial automation, solar photovoltaic systems, welding and fabrication, garment making, food and beverage service, artificial intelligence, backend web development, cloud security engineering and other trades.
source_summaries.limitations: A listed NOS/NSQ is evidence that a Nigerian training standard exists; it is not proof that every employer requires it or that every canonical role maps one-to-one to the trade title.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria Customs Service Authorised Economic Operator programme
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian importers, exporters, customs brokers, freight forwarders, transport and logistics operators
findings: The AEO material describes compliance, record management, customs knowledge, risk education, secure information exchange and supply-chain security for participating trade operators; the 2025 newsletter references the Nigeria Customs Service Act 2023 legal basis and ISO 28001 for the security tier.
source_summaries.limitations: AEO is an organisation/operator programme and does not make every listed control a personal certificate for every logistics or customs role.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria Customs Service recruitment and cadre context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian Customs Service officer recruitment, cadres, revenue, border and anti-smuggling functions
findings: The Nigeria Customs Service recruitment portal describes Superintendent, Inspectorate and Customs Assistant cadres and identifies revenue collection, trade and anti-smuggling functions; an official 2025 update reported 3,927 declared vacancies across those cadres.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes an official Nigerian Customs pathway and service context, not a current open vacancy, guaranteed appointment or one universal qualification for every customs-related role.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian Export Promotion Council logistics and freight guidance
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian export logistics, freight forwarding, warehousing and Incoterms
findings: NEPC guidance identifies transport modes, shipment conditions, freight forwarding, warehousing and Incoterms as practical export-logistics knowledge.
source_summaries.limitations: Export guidance is sector context and does not create an individual certification or vacancy claim.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian customs, tariff, trade facilitation and border-compliance context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian customs clearance, tariff and valuation, import/export documentation, trade facilitation, authorised economic operators, enforcement, border security and customs digital systems
findings: Nigeria Customs Service identifies revenue collection, trade facilitation, border security, enforcement, compliance and digital customs services as core functions.
The Nigeria Trade Portal exposes tariff search, trader guidance, manifests, declarations, licences, permits and a single-window workflow for trade actors.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian customs and trade-work context; it does not establish a vacancy count, one customs-agent licence or the requirements for every import, export, logistics or policy title.

source_summaries.name: EU-funded project delivery and international-development role signal in Nigeria
source_summaries.scope: EU-funded and ECOWAS-linked project delivery roles based in Abuja, Nigeria
findings: A 2026 Abuja project-officer vacancy describes an EU-funded ECOWAS-linked project and project-management responsibilities in Nigeria.
source_summaries.limitations: This is a dated vacancy signal, not proof of a permanent Nigerian occupation, universal requirement or demand ranking for EU-funds managers.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria procurement and purchasing vacancy signals
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria-based procurement, purchasing, sourcing, supplier, contract and supply-chain work
findings: Nigeria-focused vacancy pages identify Procurement Manager and Purchasing Manager roles across agriculture, oil and gas, manufacturing, construction, hospitality, pharmaceuticals and other sectors, with sourcing, vendor management, negotiation and supply-chain responsibilities.
source_summaries.limitations: The listings demonstrate a local procurement role family; they do not establish one universal certification, procurement system, sector requirement or national demand total.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian textile, garment and trade value-chain context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian textile and garment production, wholesale trade, import/export documentation, customs and local-content value chains
findings: CBN describes a Nigerian cotton, textile and garment value-chain resuscitation initiative, while the Nigeria Trade Portal provides textile and garment trader procedures, customs, certificates and cross-border documentation.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes a Nigerian textile-trade context; it does not establish a vacancy count or imply that every wholesale trader needs the same permit or credential.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria warehouse, logistics and supply-chain vacancy signals
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria-based warehouse management, inventory, logistics, fulfilment and end-to-end supply-chain operations
findings: Nigeria-focused listings identify Warehouse Manager, Logistics Manager, Warehouse/Logistics Manager, Inventory Manager and Operations & Supply Chain Manager work involving receiving, storage, fulfilment, dispatch, inventory accuracy, warehousing and last-mile delivery.
source_summaries.limitations: The listings demonstrate Nigerian warehouse and logistics role families; they do not establish one universal warehouse system, qualification, salary or demand total.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian project-management professional and regulatory pathways
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian project management, PMO, programme delivery, project consulting, professional development, certification and practice standards
findings: PMI Nigeria describes a Nigerian project-management professional community, learning, job and networking pathways; CIPMN describes Nigerian training, examination, certification, licensing, supervision and standards for project managers and PMO or consulting practitioners.
source_summaries.limitations: The bodies establish professional and training pathways, not a national vacancy count or a universal requirement that every project or programme worker hold a particular credential.

source_summaries.limitations: The source supports a Nigerian marine and port-inspection function that is adjacent to the canonical marine cargo inspector title; it does not establish one universal job title, vacancy count or personal certification requirement for every cargo-inspection role.

source_summaries.scope: Nigerian occupational and skills pathways across agriculture, animal husbandry, engineering, construction, ICT, fashion, hospitality, health and safety

source_summaries.name: Nigeria Customs Service Authorised Economic Operator programme
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian importers, exporters, customs brokers, freight forwarders, transport and logistics operators
findings: The AEO material describes compliance, record management, customs knowledge, risk education, secure information exchange and supply-chain security for participating trade operators; the 2025 newsletter references the Nigeria Customs Service Act 2023 legal basis and ISO 28001 for the security tier.
source_summaries.limitations: AEO is an organisation/operator programme and does not make every listed control a personal certificate for every logistics or customs role.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria Customs Service recruitment and cadre context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian Customs Service officer recruitment, cadres, revenue, border and anti-smuggling functions
findings: The Nigeria Customs Service recruitment portal describes Superintendent, Inspectorate and Customs Assistant cadres and identifies revenue collection, trade and anti-smuggling functions; an official 2025 update reported 3,927 declared vacancies across those cadres.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes an official Nigerian Customs pathway and service context, not a current open vacancy, guaranteed appointment or one universal qualification for every customs-related role.

source_summaries.scope: Nigerian export logistics, freight forwarding, warehousing and Incoterms

source_summaries.name: Nigerian customs, tariff, trade facilitation and border-compliance context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian customs clearance, tariff and valuation, import/export documentation, trade facilitation, authorised economic operators, enforcement, border security and customs digital systems
findings: Nigeria Customs Service identifies revenue collection, trade facilitation, border security, enforcement, compliance and digital customs services as core functions.
The Nigeria Trade Portal exposes tariff search, trader guidance, manifests, declarations, licences, permits and a single-window workflow for trade actors.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian customs and trade-work context; it does not establish a vacancy count, one customs-agent licence or the requirements for every import, export, logistics or policy title.

source_summaries.scope: EU-funded and ECOWAS-linked project delivery roles based in Abuja, Nigeria
findings: A 2026 Abuja project-officer vacancy describes an EU-funded ECOWAS-linked project and project-management responsibilities in Nigeria.
source_summaries.limitations: This is a dated vacancy signal, not proof of a permanent Nigerian occupation, universal requirement or demand ranking for EU-funds managers.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria procurement and purchasing vacancy signals
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria-based procurement, purchasing, sourcing, supplier, contract and supply-chain work
findings: Nigeria-focused vacancy pages identify Procurement Manager and Purchasing Manager roles across agriculture, oil and gas, manufacturing, construction, hospitality, pharmaceuticals and other sectors, with sourcing, vendor management, negotiation and supply-chain responsibilities.
source_summaries.limitations: The listings demonstrate a local procurement role family; they do not establish one universal certification, procurement system, sector requirement or national demand total.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian textile, garment and trade value-chain context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian textile and garment production, wholesale trade, import/export documentation, customs and local-content value chains
findings: CBN describes a Nigerian cotton, textile and garment value-chain resuscitation initiative, while the Nigeria Trade Portal provides textile and garment trader procedures, customs, certificates and cross-border documentation.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes a Nigerian textile-trade context; it does not establish a vacancy count or imply that every wholesale trader needs the same permit or credential.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria warehouse, logistics and supply-chain vacancy signals
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria-based warehouse management, inventory, logistics, fulfilment and end-to-end supply-chain operations
findings: Nigeria-focused listings identify Warehouse Manager, Logistics Manager, Warehouse/Logistics Manager, Inventory Manager and Operations & Supply Chain Manager work involving receiving, storage, fulfilment, dispatch, inventory accuracy, warehousing and last-mile delivery.
source_summaries.limitations: The listings demonstrate Nigerian warehouse and logistics role families; they do not establish one universal warehouse system, qualification, salary or demand total.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian project-management professional and regulatory pathways
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian project management, PMO, programme delivery, project consulting, professional development, certification and practice standards
findings: PMI Nigeria describes a Nigerian project-management professional community, learning, job and networking pathways; CIPMN describes Nigerian training, examination, certification, licensing, supervision and standards for project managers and PMO or consulting practitioners.
source_summaries.limitations: The bodies establish professional and training pathways, not a national vacancy count or a universal requirement that every project or programme worker hold a particular credential.

source_summaries.scope: Nigerian port-state control, marine surveying, ship inspection, cargo-related safety documentation and maritime compliance
findings: NIMASA describes port-state-control inspections, marine surveyors boarding ships, checking certificates and documentation, examining vessels and crews, recording deficiencies and applying Nigerian and IMO-aligned inspection procedures.
source_summaries.limitations: The source supports a Nigerian marine and port-inspection function that is adjacent to the canonical marine cargo inspector title; it does not establish one universal job title, vacancy count or personal certification requirement for every cargo-inspection role.

source_summaries.scope: Nigerian diplomatic missions, consular work, ambassadorial appointments and Foreign Affairs Officer cadres

source_summaries.scope: Nigerian public administration, policy, planning, public-sector compliance, anti-corruption, ethics, data protection and government records or programme work

source_summaries.limitations: These sources establish Nigerian public-service and compliance functions; they are not evidence that every global public-office title exists locally, nor a universal qualification or vacancy count for each role.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian legal education, court staff and judicial training context

source_summaries.scope: Nigerian legal, compliance, audit, privacy and data-protection practice

source_summaries.limitations: The source supports data-protection and compliance capability; it does not make every lawyer, compliance officer or IT worker a DPCO or data-protection specialist.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria Foreign Service and Ministry of Foreign Affairs role context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian diplomatic missions, consular work, ambassadorial appointments and Foreign Affairs Officer cadres
findings: Nigeria's Ministry of Foreign Affairs lists embassies, high commissions, consulates and permanent missions and its current communications identify ambassadorial and consular functions.

source_summaries.limitations: These sources establish Nigerian public-service and compliance functions; they are not evidence that every global public-office title exists locally, nor a universal qualification or vacancy count for each role.

findings: OHCSF publishes Nigerian public-service rules, policy and civil-service resources; ICPC describes review of public-body systems, anti-corruption transparency units, monitoring, reporting, ethics and compliance work in MDAs; NDPC documents data-protection compliance, audits, data-protection officers and licensed compliance organisations in Nigeria.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources establish Nigerian public-service and compliance functions; they are not evidence that every global public-office title exists locally, nor a universal qualification or vacancy count for each role.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian legal education, court staff and judicial training context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian legal education, Bar vocational training, court staff, judicial administration, legal research, continuing legal education and justice-sector professional development
findings: The Nigerian Law School describes vocational training for barristers and solicitors and publishes Bar admission and Call-to-the-Bar pathways.
The National Judicial Institute describes continuing education for judicial officers and supporting court staff, including judicial administration and legal-research ICT tools.
source_summaries.limitations: The Bar and judicial pathways apply to defined legal or court duties; they do not make every policy, compliance, administrative or social-services role a legal profession.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian Notary Public Regulations and electronic notary register
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian notarial practice, registration and digital-signature/seal context
findings: The 2026 notice and electronic notary information describe registration on the Electronic Notary Register and compliance with Nigerian notarial practice requirements.
source_summaries.limitations: This is specific to notarial practice and does not apply to every legal, compliance or administrative role.

source_summaries.name: Public Complaints Commission statutory Ombudsman context
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria's statutory ombudsman, administrative-justice, complaint-investigation and public-accountability functions
findings: The Public Complaints Commission states that it acts as Nigeria's statutory ombudsman and investigates complaints about administrative injustice, public bodies, companies and officials, while making recommendations and protecting complaint confidentiality.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes the Nigerian ombudsman institution and its work; it is not a vacancy count or a single universal qualification for every legal, investigative or complaints role.

source_summaries.scope: Nigerian sector-skills governance and occupational-standard development across ICT, engineering, transport/logistics and other sectors
findings: The guidelines describe sector-skills-council structures used to coordinate occupational standards, industry participation and skills development in Nigeria.
source_summaries.limitations: The guidelines support skills-governance context and do not establish a credential or demand signal for an individual role.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria Customs Service recruitment and cadre context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian Customs Service officer recruitment, cadres, revenue, border and anti-smuggling functions
findings: The Nigeria Customs Service recruitment portal describes Superintendent, Inspectorate and Customs Assistant cadres and identifies revenue collection, trade and anti-smuggling functions; an official 2025 update reported 3,927 declared vacancies across those cadres.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes an official Nigerian Customs pathway and service context, not a current open vacancy, guaranteed appointment or one universal qualification for every customs-related role.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria Data Protection Commission data protection and DPO certification guidance
Nigeria Data Protection Commission legal-practice and compliance guidance
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian legal, compliance, audit, privacy and data-protection practice
findings: NDPC guidance discusses accountability, data minimisation, confidentiality, records, audits and compliance returns for legal practices and organisations handling personal data; it also describes licensed Data Protection Compliance Organisations and relevant expertise areas.
source_summaries.limitations: The source supports data-protection and compliance capability; it does not make every lawyer, compliance officer or IT worker a DPCO or data-protection specialist.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian customs, tariff, trade facilitation and border-compliance context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian customs clearance, tariff and valuation, import/export documentation, trade facilitation, authorised economic operators, enforcement, border security and customs digital systems
findings: Nigeria Customs Service identifies revenue collection, trade facilitation, border security, enforcement, compliance and digital customs services as core functions.
The Nigeria Trade Portal exposes tariff search, trader guidance, manifests, declarations, licences, permits and a single-window workflow for trade actors.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian customs and trade-work context; it does not establish a vacancy count, one customs-agent licence or the requirements for every import, export, logistics or policy title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian public-service administration, integrity, privacy and compliance context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian public administration, policy, planning, public-sector compliance, anti-corruption, ethics, data protection and government records or programme work
findings: OHCSF publishes Nigerian public-service rules, policy and civil-service resources; ICPC describes review of public-body systems, anti-corruption transparency units, monitoring, reporting, ethics and compliance work in MDAs; NDPC documents data-protection compliance, audits, data-protection officers and licensed compliance organisations in Nigeria.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources establish Nigerian public-service and compliance functions; they are not evidence that every global public-office title exists locally, nor a universal qualification or vacancy count for each role.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian environmental science, biodiversity, water-quality and environmental-health context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian environmental science, environmental health, biodiversity conservation, water and air quality, pollution control, environmental audit, natural resources and sustainability
findings: NESREA describes Nigerian environmental protection, biodiversity conservation, water-quality and pollution standards, environmental audits, environmental data, ecosystem conservation and research; EHCON regulates and licenses environmental-health specialists, officers, technicians and assistants; the Federal Ministry of Environment identifies chemical, waste, sewage, air-emissions and environmental-health functions.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian environmental and environmental-health practice context; it is not a national vacancy count and environmental-health registration should not be applied to every environmental scientist or ecologist.

source_summaries.name: NIMASA port-state and marine inspection context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian port-state control, marine surveying, ship inspection, cargo-related safety documentation and maritime compliance
findings: NIMASA describes port-state-control inspections, marine surveyors boarding ships, checking certificates and documentation, examining vessels and crews, recording deficiencies and applying Nigerian and IMO-aligned inspection procedures.
source_summaries.limitations: The source supports a Nigerian marine and port-inspection function that is adjacent to the canonical marine cargo inspector title; it does not establish one universal job title, vacancy count or personal certification requirement for every cargo-inspection role.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria Immigration Service operational and service context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian immigration, border-management, passport, visa and residence-permit functions
findings: The Nigeria Immigration Service identifies border-management, passport, visa, ECOWAS travel and residence-permit services, while the Ministry of Interior describes immigration and expatriate-work-permit administration as part of the national service environment.
source_summaries.limitations: Official service functions establish the Nigerian role family and institutional context; they do not establish a current vacancy, rank-equivalence or universal qualification for every immigration or passport role.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian Notary Public Regulations and electronic notary register
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian notarial practice, registration and digital-signature/seal context
findings: The 2026 notice and electronic notary information describe registration on the Electronic Notary Register and compliance with Nigerian notarial practice requirements.
source_summaries.limitations: This is specific to notarial practice and does not apply to every legal, compliance or administrative role.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria Procurement Certification Programme
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian public and private procurement practitioners
findings: The programme describes four Nigerian procurement-certification tiers and skills including communication, teamwork, time management, deadlines, ethics and risk management, with prerequisites varying by tier.
source_summaries.limitations: The pathway is for procurement practice and does not apply to every purchasing, logistics, project or administrative role.

source_summaries.name: Project Managers Development Association of Nigeria
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian project-management professional development and IPMA-aligned certification levels
findings: PMDAN identifies itself as Nigeria's IPMA member association, describes four certification levels and publishes project-execution and project-management learning activities.
source_summaries.limitations: Professional-body certification is a pathway, not a universal employer requirement for every project-support or coordination role.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria Police Service Commission recruitment and inspector context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian police recruitment, inspector and specialist appointment, detective training and law-enforcement work
findings: The Police Service Commission identifies recruitment of constables, appointment of cadet ASPs and Inspectors and specialist appointments; Nigeria Police Academy materials describe cadet Inspector training including police duties, law, detective courses and practical attachment.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes an official Nigerian policing pathway and training context, not a current vacancy for every police rank or a claim that civilian criminal-investigator titles map directly to a police appointment.

source_summaries.name: Public Complaints Commission statutory Ombudsman context
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria's statutory ombudsman, administrative-justice, complaint-investigation and public-accountability functions
findings: The Public Complaints Commission states that it acts as Nigeria's statutory ombudsman and investigates complaints about administrative injustice, public bodies, companies and officials, while making recommendations and protecting complaint confidentiality.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes the Nigerian ombudsman institution and its work; it is not a vacancy count or a single universal qualification for every legal, investigative or complaints role.
