source_summaries.name: Architects Registration Council of Nigeria registration guidance
Nigerian built-environment regulators and bodies
Construction and Labour Market Information System Nigerian construction National Occupational Standards
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian construction trades including electrical, carpentry and joinery, masonry, painting, plumbing and tiling
findings: C-LMIS provides Nigerian construction National Occupational Standards across building trades, including electrical, carpentry and joinery, masonry, painting and decorating, plumbing and tiling.
source_summaries.limitations: The standards support construction-trade skills and pathways; they do not establish a licence for every worker or a universal requirement for construction managers and engineers.

source_summaries.name: COREN 2026 engineering regulation and public-safety reforms
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian engineering practice, registration, public safety, project monitoring and anti-quackery context
findings: COREN's 2026 reforms emphasise qualified and registered practitioners, public safety, project monitoring and enforcement against unqualified engineering practice.
source_summaries.limitations: The source supports regulated-engineering context; it is not a personal registration requirement for every technician or non-engineering role in an engineering organisation.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria geological and engineering-geology vacancy signals
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria-based geological engineering, geotechnical, mining, construction and infrastructure work
findings: Nigeria-focused job listings identify Geological Engineer, Engineering Geologist, Wellsite Geologist and related geotechnical roles in Abuja, Lagos and other Nigerian locations.
source_summaries.limitations: The checked listings demonstrate a Nigerian geological-engineering role family; they do not establish one universal registration, sector requirement or tool stack for every geology or geotechnical role.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria construction engineer vacancy signal
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria-based construction engineering and field-project work
findings: A Nigeria-based International Energy Services Limited posting identified a Construction Engineer role in Lagos with construction planning, execution, quality, scheduling and safety responsibilities.
source_summaries.limitations: This is a dated vacancy signal for one construction-engineering role; it is not a national demand count, universal COREN requirement or evidence for every engineering speciality.

source_summaries.name: Jobberman Nigeria jobs
MyJobMag Nigeria feeds
National Bureau of Statistics Nigeria Labour Force Survey
Nigerian construction and building-trade occupational standards and curricula
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian masonry, painting and decoration, carpentry and joinery, construction equipment, openings, doors, windows and related building-trade training
findings: NBTE lists validated Nigerian occupational standards for masonry, painting and decoration, tiling, carpentry and joinery and construction-equipment operation; Nigerian curricula describe door and window construction, frames, materials and fixing methods; C-LMIS/CORBON publishes construction-trade standards for masonry works.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources support Nigerian occupational and training families, not a vacancy count or a claim that every named installation or supervisory title is a separate regulated occupation.

source_summaries.name: NBTE National Occupational Standards and National Skills Qualifications brochure, January 2026 edition
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian occupational and skills pathways across agriculture, animal husbandry, engineering, construction, ICT, fashion, hospitality, health and safety
findings: The brochure lists Nigerian NOS/NSQ pathways including aquaculture, crop production, animal husbandry, industrial automation, solar photovoltaic systems, welding and fabrication, garment making, food and beverage service, artificial intelligence, backend web development, cloud security engineering and other trades.
source_summaries.limitations: A listed NOS/NSQ is evidence that a Nigerian training standard exists; it is not proof that every employer requires it or that every canonical role maps one-to-one to the trade title.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria civil-engineering technician vacancy signal
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria-based civil-engineering technician, construction installation and commissioning support
findings: A Nigeria-focused construction vacancy page identifies Civil Engineering Technician work involving construction, installation and commissioning support, engineering drawings, analysis and digital reporting.
source_summaries.limitations: This is a vacancy signal for one role family; it does not establish a national demand count, universal qualification or one software stack for every civil-engineering technician.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian construction, building trades and builder-standards context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian building construction, building trades, construction skills, safety, quality, professional standards, masonry, carpentry, joinery, painting, plumbing, electrical installation, tiling and decorative stonework
findings: C-LMIS/CORBON identifies construction as a major Nigerian employer and publishes National Occupational Standards for building trades including electrical installation, carpentry and joinery, masonry, painting and decoration, plumbing, tiling and decorative stonework; CORBON describes standards, compliance, safety, sustainability, builder registration and practice-licence verification.
source_summaries.limitations: The sources support the named building-trade and builder families; they do not establish a Nigerian counterpart for every specialist engineering, transport, energy or infrastructure role in the library.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian construction-equipment operator training context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian construction-equipment operation, excavators, bulldozers, graders, loaders, concrete mixers, maintenance, workplace safety and road regulations
findings: NBTE National Skills Qualifications for Nigerian construction-equipment operations identify operator-helper and operator competencies, daily checks, equipment maintenance, health and safety, road and workplace regulations, and specific excavator, bulldozer, grader, loader and concrete-truck-mixer operation units.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian construction-equipment training context, not a vacancy count or a local counterpart for every mining, snow, cable-vehicle, elevator or specialist crane title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian energy planning, efficiency and sustainable-energy context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian energy policy, planning, statistics, renewable energy, energy efficiency, electricity, fossil fuels and sustainable-energy development
findings: The Energy Commission of Nigeria identifies national energy planning and policy implementation, energy statistics, energy information systems, electricity and fossil-fuel functions, renewable-energy research and energy-efficiency or sustainable-development work.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian energy-sector and planning context, not a universal building-assessor licence, project-vacancy count or qualification for every hydropower, pipeline, energy or conservation title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian hospitality, catering, travel and tourism training and regulation context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian hotels, restaurants, catering, accommodation, front office, housekeeping, food and beverage, travel, tours, events, recreation, tourism promotion and hospitality standards
findings: The Federal Ministry describes NIHOTOUR as Nigeria's hospitality and tourism training arm with professional and technical programmes; NTDA describes national tourism development, regulation, promotion, capacity building and accreditation of hotels, restaurants, travel agencies, tour operators and related enterprises; official sector sources identify hotel, catering, recreation, tourism safety and tourism-ethics functions.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources establish Nigerian hospitality and tourism role-family context, not a vacancy count or a universal certification for every service, food, travel or entertainment title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian inland-waterway transport, marine safety and operations context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian inland-waterway navigation, vessel operations, cargo handling, warehousing, ferry services, pilotage, safety inspection, traffic management, maritime security and intermodal transport
findings: NIWA describes statutory Nigerian responsibility for inland-waterway development and regulation, vessel operations, ferry services, cargo handling, storage, stevedoring, pilotage, vessel traffic management, safety inspections, search and rescue and maritime security; it also describes training for boat operators and skippers.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian inland-waterway role and operational context; it does not establish a counterpart for every air, rail, pipeline or ocean-shipping title, or one universal licence for every waterway role.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian rail, airport, airspace and transport-operations context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian railway stations, rail operations, train safety, signalling, route planning, airport operations, baggage, airspace and air-transport services, aviation fuel and road-transport administration
findings: NRC describes passenger and goods carriage, station management, train safety, control and signalling, route planning, traffic and commercial operations; NCAA regulates air transport, aviation fuel and aerodrome services; FAAN manages Nigerian commercial airports, airport operations, cargo and passenger services; NAMA describes air-traffic-management, communications, navigation and surveillance; the Federal Ministry of Transportation lists rail, road, engineering and transport-planning functions.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources establish Nigerian rail, airport, airspace and transport-operation context, not a vacancy count or a counterpart for every global vehicle, pipeline, event, warehouse or specialist infrastructure title.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria scaffolding supervisor and scaffolder vacancy signals
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria-based scaffolding supervision, inspection, erection, modification and dismantling work
findings: Nigeria-based EPC and construction listings identify Scaffolding Supervisor and scaffolder work involving safe erection, inspection, modification, dismantling, access planning, inventory and risk assessment; Nigerian offshore-safety course listings include scaffolding supervisor and scaffolder training.
source_summaries.limitations: The sources demonstrate a Nigerian scaffolding role family and training signal; they do not establish one universal certificate, code, employer requirement or national demand total.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian security, fire, border and correctional-service context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian fire prevention and rescue, emergency response, border security, immigration control, policing, correctional custody, probation, rehabilitation and public safety
findings: The Federal Fire Service describes fire prevention, mitigation, rescue, life and property protection, training and emergency response; NIS describes border control, surveillance, immigration compliance, airport, seaport, intelligence and cybersecurity functions; NCoS describes secure and humane custody, risk and needs assessment, rehabilitation, probation, parole and non-custodial measures; PSC/NPF materials establish Nigerian police recruitment and service context.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources support the named public-service families and functions; they do not establish a counterpart, private-security licence or vacancy count for every global guard, transport, animal, gaming or specialist rescue title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian environmental science, biodiversity, water-quality and environmental-health context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian environmental science, environmental health, biodiversity conservation, water and air quality, pollution control, environmental audit, natural resources and sustainability
findings: NESREA describes Nigerian environmental protection, biodiversity conservation, water-quality and pollution standards, environmental audits, environmental data, ecosystem conservation and research; EHCON regulates and licenses environmental-health specialists, officers, technicians and assistants; the Federal Ministry of Environment identifies chemical, waste, sewage, air-emissions and environmental-health functions.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian environmental and environmental-health practice context; it is not a national vacancy count and environmental-health registration should not be applied to every environmental scientist or ecologist.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria pipeline-engineer vacancy signals
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria-based oil-and-gas, water and infrastructure pipeline design, construction, integrity and maintenance work
findings: Nigeria-focused job postings identify Pipeline Engineer and Pipeline/Corrosion Engineer roles in Port Harcourt, Lagos and other Nigerian operations, covering design, construction, integrity, maintenance, HSE and technical monitoring.
source_summaries.limitations: The postings demonstrate local pipeline-engineering work; they do not establish one universal pipeline code, software stack, professional-registration route or demand total for every sector.

source_summaries.name: Quantity Surveyors Registration Board of Nigeria 2024 newsletter
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian quantity-surveying practice and professional registration context
findings: The QSRBN newsletter supplies Nigerian quantity-surveying professional-body context and practice material.
source_summaries.limitations: The newsletter supports professional context; specific registration gates must be shown only where the applicable rule is explicit.

source_summaries.name: Standards Organisation of Nigeria building and construction conference
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian building construction standards, structural integrity, materials, risk management and sustainable development
findings: SON reported a 2024 national conference emphasizing standards practice, structural integrity, sustainable materials and risk management in Nigeria's building and construction industry.
source_summaries.limitations: Conference and standards context does not assign one tool or credential to every construction role.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria water-engineer vacancy and recruitment signals
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria-based water, wastewater, reticulation, hydraulic and public-infrastructure engineering work
findings: Nigeria-focused recruitment and vacancy pages identify Water Engineer work involving water networks, treatment, hydraulic systems, reticulation, drainage, sewage and public or private infrastructure across Nigerian locations.
source_summaries.limitations: The sources demonstrate a Nigerian water-engineering role family and associated skills; they do not establish one universal employer requirement, professional licence or software stack.

source_summaries.name: COREN 2026 engineering regulation and public-safety reforms
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian engineering practice, registration, public safety, project monitoring and anti-quackery context
findings: COREN's 2026 reforms emphasise qualified and registered practitioners, public safety, project monitoring and enforcement against unqualified engineering practice.
source_summaries.limitations: The source supports regulated-engineering context; it is not a personal registration requirement for every technician or non-engineering role in an engineering organisation.

findings: Nigeria-focused job listings identify Geological Engineer, Engineering Geologist, Wellsite Geologist and related geotechnical roles in Abuja, Lagos and other Nigerian locations.
source_summaries.limitations: The checked listings demonstrate a Nigerian geological-engineering role family; they do not establish one universal registration, sector requirement or tool stack for every geology or geotechnical role.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria construction engineer vacancy signal
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria-based construction engineering and field-project work
findings: A Nigeria-based International Energy Services Limited posting identified a Construction Engineer role in Lagos with construction planning, execution, quality, scheduling and safety responsibilities.
source_summaries.limitations: This is a dated vacancy signal for one construction-engineering role; it is not a national demand count, universal COREN requirement or evidence for every engineering speciality.

MyJobMag Nigeria feeds
National Bureau of Statistics Nigeria Labour Force Survey
Nigerian construction and building-trade occupational standards and curricula
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian masonry, painting and decoration, carpentry and joinery, construction equipment, openings, doors, windows and related building-trade training
findings: NBTE lists validated Nigerian occupational standards for masonry, painting and decoration, tiling, carpentry and joinery and construction-equipment operation; Nigerian curricula describe door and window construction, frames, materials and fixing methods; C-LMIS/CORBON publishes construction-trade standards for masonry works.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources support Nigerian occupational and training families, not a vacancy count or a claim that every named installation or supervisory title is a separate regulated occupation.

source_summaries.name: NBTE National Occupational Standards and National Skills Qualifications brochure, January 2026 edition
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian occupational and skills pathways across agriculture, animal husbandry, engineering, construction, ICT, fashion, hospitality, health and safety
findings: The brochure lists Nigerian NOS/NSQ pathways including aquaculture, crop production, animal husbandry, industrial automation, solar photovoltaic systems, welding and fabrication, garment making, food and beverage service, artificial intelligence, backend web development, cloud security engineering and other trades.
source_summaries.limitations: A listed NOS/NSQ is evidence that a Nigerian training standard exists; it is not proof that every employer requires it or that every canonical role maps one-to-one to the trade title.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria civil-engineering technician vacancy signal
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria-based civil-engineering technician, construction installation and commissioning support
findings: A Nigeria-focused construction vacancy page identifies Civil Engineering Technician work involving construction, installation and commissioning support, engineering drawings, analysis and digital reporting.
source_summaries.limitations: This is a vacancy signal for one role family; it does not establish a national demand count, universal qualification or one software stack for every civil-engineering technician.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian construction, building trades and builder-standards context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian building construction, building trades, construction skills, safety, quality, professional standards, masonry, carpentry, joinery, painting, plumbing, electrical installation, tiling and decorative stonework
findings: C-LMIS/CORBON identifies construction as a major Nigerian employer and publishes National Occupational Standards for building trades including electrical installation, carpentry and joinery, masonry, painting and decoration, plumbing, tiling and decorative stonework; CORBON describes standards, compliance, safety, sustainability, builder registration and practice-licence verification.
source_summaries.limitations: The sources support the named building-trade and builder families; they do not establish a Nigerian counterpart for every specialist engineering, transport, energy or infrastructure role in the library.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian construction-equipment operator training context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian construction-equipment operation, excavators, bulldozers, graders, loaders, concrete mixers, maintenance, workplace safety and road regulations
findings: NBTE National Skills Qualifications for Nigerian construction-equipment operations identify operator-helper and operator competencies, daily checks, equipment maintenance, health and safety, road and workplace regulations, and specific excavator, bulldozer, grader, loader and concrete-truck-mixer operation units.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian construction-equipment training context, not a vacancy count or a local counterpart for every mining, snow, cable-vehicle, elevator or specialist crane title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian energy planning, efficiency and sustainable-energy context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian energy policy, planning, statistics, renewable energy, energy efficiency, electricity, fossil fuels and sustainable-energy development
findings: The Energy Commission of Nigeria identifies national energy planning and policy implementation, energy statistics, energy information systems, electricity and fossil-fuel functions, renewable-energy research and energy-efficiency or sustainable-development work.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian energy-sector and planning context, not a universal building-assessor licence, project-vacancy count or qualification for every hydropower, pipeline, energy or conservation title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian hospitality, catering, travel and tourism training and regulation context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian hotels, restaurants, catering, accommodation, front office, housekeeping, food and beverage, travel, tours, events, recreation, tourism promotion and hospitality standards
findings: The Federal Ministry describes NIHOTOUR as Nigeria's hospitality and tourism training arm with professional and technical programmes; NTDA describes national tourism development, regulation, promotion, capacity building and accreditation of hotels, restaurants, travel agencies, tour operators and related enterprises; official sector sources identify hotel, catering, recreation, tourism safety and tourism-ethics functions.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources establish Nigerian hospitality and tourism role-family context, not a vacancy count or a universal certification for every service, food, travel or entertainment title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian inland-waterway transport, marine safety and operations context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian inland-waterway navigation, vessel operations, cargo handling, warehousing, ferry services, pilotage, safety inspection, traffic management, maritime security and intermodal transport
findings: NIWA describes statutory Nigerian responsibility for inland-waterway development and regulation, vessel operations, ferry services, cargo handling, storage, stevedoring, pilotage, vessel traffic management, safety inspections, search and rescue and maritime security; it also describes training for boat operators and skippers.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian inland-waterway role and operational context; it does not establish a counterpart for every air, rail, pipeline or ocean-shipping title, or one universal licence for every waterway role.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian rail, airport, airspace and transport-operations context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian railway stations, rail operations, train safety, signalling, route planning, airport operations, baggage, airspace and air-transport services, aviation fuel and road-transport administration
findings: NRC describes passenger and goods carriage, station management, train safety, control and signalling, route planning, traffic and commercial operations; NCAA regulates air transport, aviation fuel and aerodrome services; FAAN manages Nigerian commercial airports, airport operations, cargo and passenger services; NAMA describes air-traffic-management, communications, navigation and surveillance; the Federal Ministry of Transportation lists rail, road, engineering and transport-planning functions.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources establish Nigerian rail, airport, airspace and transport-operation context, not a vacancy count or a counterpart for every global vehicle, pipeline, event, warehouse or specialist infrastructure title.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria scaffolding supervisor and scaffolder vacancy signals
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria-based scaffolding supervision, inspection, erection, modification and dismantling work
findings: Nigeria-based EPC and construction listings identify Scaffolding Supervisor and scaffolder work involving safe erection, inspection, modification, dismantling, access planning, inventory and risk assessment; Nigerian offshore-safety course listings include scaffolding supervisor and scaffolder training.
source_summaries.limitations: The sources demonstrate a Nigerian scaffolding role family and training signal; they do not establish one universal certificate, code, employer requirement or national demand total.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian security, fire, border and correctional-service context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian fire prevention and rescue, emergency response, border security, immigration control, policing, correctional custody, probation, rehabilitation and public safety
findings: The Federal Fire Service describes fire prevention, mitigation, rescue, life and property protection, training and emergency response; NIS describes border control, surveillance, immigration compliance, airport, seaport, intelligence and cybersecurity functions; NCoS describes secure and humane custody, risk and needs assessment, rehabilitation, probation, parole and non-custodial measures; PSC/NPF materials establish Nigerian police recruitment and service context.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources support the named public-service families and functions; they do not establish a counterpart, private-security licence or vacancy count for every global guard, transport, animal, gaming or specialist rescue title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian environmental science, biodiversity, water-quality and environmental-health context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian environmental science, environmental health, biodiversity conservation, water and air quality, pollution control, environmental audit, natural resources and sustainability
findings: NESREA describes Nigerian environmental protection, biodiversity conservation, water-quality and pollution standards, environmental audits, environmental data, ecosystem conservation and research; EHCON regulates and licenses environmental-health specialists, officers, technicians and assistants; the Federal Ministry of Environment identifies chemical, waste, sewage, air-emissions and environmental-health functions.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian environmental and environmental-health practice context; it is not a national vacancy count and environmental-health registration should not be applied to every environmental scientist or ecologist.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria pipeline-engineer vacancy signals
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria-based oil-and-gas, water and infrastructure pipeline design, construction, integrity and maintenance work
findings: Nigeria-focused job postings identify Pipeline Engineer and Pipeline/Corrosion Engineer roles in Port Harcourt, Lagos and other Nigerian operations, covering design, construction, integrity, maintenance, HSE and technical monitoring.
source_summaries.limitations: The postings demonstrate local pipeline-engineering work; they do not establish one universal pipeline code, software stack, professional-registration route or demand total for every sector.

source_summaries.name: Quantity Surveyors Registration Board of Nigeria 2024 newsletter
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian quantity-surveying practice and professional registration context
findings: The QSRBN newsletter supplies Nigerian quantity-surveying professional-body context and practice material.
source_summaries.limitations: The newsletter supports professional context; specific registration gates must be shown only where the applicable rule is explicit.

source_summaries.name: Standards Organisation of Nigeria building and construction conference
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian building construction standards, structural integrity, materials, risk management and sustainable development
findings: SON reported a 2024 national conference emphasizing standards practice, structural integrity, sustainable materials and risk management in Nigeria's building and construction industry.
source_summaries.limitations: Conference and standards context does not assign one tool or credential to every construction role.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria water-engineer vacancy and recruitment signals
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria-based water, wastewater, reticulation, hydraulic and public-infrastructure engineering work
findings: Nigeria-focused recruitment and vacancy pages identify Water Engineer work involving water networks, treatment, hydraulic systems, reticulation, drainage, sewage and public or private infrastructure across Nigerian locations.
source_summaries.limitations: The sources demonstrate a Nigerian water-engineering role family and associated skills; they do not establish one universal employer requirement, professional licence or software stack.

source_summaries.limitations: The standards support construction-trade skills and pathways; they do not establish a licence for every worker or a universal requirement for construction managers and engineers.

source_summaries.name: COREN 2026 engineering regulation and public-safety reforms
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian engineering practice, registration, public safety, project monitoring and anti-quackery context
findings: COREN's 2026 reforms emphasise qualified and registered practitioners, public safety, project monitoring and enforcement against unqualified engineering practice.
source_summaries.limitations: The source supports regulated-engineering context; it is not a personal registration requirement for every technician or non-engineering role in an engineering organisation.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria geological and engineering-geology vacancy signals
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria-based geological engineering, geotechnical, mining, construction and infrastructure work
findings: Nigeria-focused job listings identify Geological Engineer, Engineering Geologist, Wellsite Geologist and related geotechnical roles in Abuja, Lagos and other Nigerian locations.
source_summaries.limitations: The checked listings demonstrate a Nigerian geological-engineering role family; they do not establish one universal registration, sector requirement or tool stack for every geology or geotechnical role.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria construction engineer vacancy signal
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria-based construction engineering and field-project work
findings: A Nigeria-based International Energy Services Limited posting identified a Construction Engineer role in Lagos with construction planning, execution, quality, scheduling and safety responsibilities.
source_summaries.limitations: This is a dated vacancy signal for one construction-engineering role; it is not a national demand count, universal COREN requirement or evidence for every engineering speciality.

MyJobMag Nigeria feeds
National Bureau of Statistics Nigeria Labour Force Survey
Nigerian construction and building-trade occupational standards and curricula
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian masonry, painting and decoration, carpentry and joinery, construction equipment, openings, doors, windows and related building-trade training
findings: NBTE lists validated Nigerian occupational standards for masonry, painting and decoration, tiling, carpentry and joinery and construction-equipment operation; Nigerian curricula describe door and window construction, frames, materials and fixing methods; C-LMIS/CORBON publishes construction-trade standards for masonry works.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources support Nigerian occupational and training families, not a vacancy count or a claim that every named installation or supervisory title is a separate regulated occupation.

source_summaries.name: NBTE National Occupational Standards and National Skills Qualifications brochure, January 2026 edition
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian occupational and skills pathways across agriculture, animal husbandry, engineering, construction, ICT, fashion, hospitality, health and safety
findings: The brochure lists Nigerian NOS/NSQ pathways including aquaculture, crop production, animal husbandry, industrial automation, solar photovoltaic systems, welding and fabrication, garment making, food and beverage service, artificial intelligence, backend web development, cloud security engineering and other trades.
source_summaries.limitations: A listed NOS/NSQ is evidence that a Nigerian training standard exists; it is not proof that every employer requires it or that every canonical role maps one-to-one to the trade title.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria civil-engineering technician vacancy signal
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria-based civil-engineering technician, construction installation and commissioning support
findings: A Nigeria-focused construction vacancy page identifies Civil Engineering Technician work involving construction, installation and commissioning support, engineering drawings, analysis and digital reporting.
source_summaries.limitations: This is a vacancy signal for one role family; it does not establish a national demand count, universal qualification or one software stack for every civil-engineering technician.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian construction, building trades and builder-standards context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian building construction, building trades, construction skills, safety, quality, professional standards, masonry, carpentry, joinery, painting, plumbing, electrical installation, tiling and decorative stonework
findings: C-LMIS/CORBON identifies construction as a major Nigerian employer and publishes National Occupational Standards for building trades including electrical installation, carpentry and joinery, masonry, painting and decoration, plumbing, tiling and decorative stonework; CORBON describes standards, compliance, safety, sustainability, builder registration and practice-licence verification.
source_summaries.limitations: The sources support the named building-trade and builder families; they do not establish a Nigerian counterpart for every specialist engineering, transport, energy or infrastructure role in the library.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian construction-equipment operator training context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian construction-equipment operation, excavators, bulldozers, graders, loaders, concrete mixers, maintenance, workplace safety and road regulations
findings: NBTE National Skills Qualifications for Nigerian construction-equipment operations identify operator-helper and operator competencies, daily checks, equipment maintenance, health and safety, road and workplace regulations, and specific excavator, bulldozer, grader, loader and concrete-truck-mixer operation units.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian construction-equipment training context, not a vacancy count or a local counterpart for every mining, snow, cable-vehicle, elevator or specialist crane title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian energy planning, efficiency and sustainable-energy context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian energy policy, planning, statistics, renewable energy, energy efficiency, electricity, fossil fuels and sustainable-energy development
findings: The Energy Commission of Nigeria identifies national energy planning and policy implementation, energy statistics, energy information systems, electricity and fossil-fuel functions, renewable-energy research and energy-efficiency or sustainable-development work.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian energy-sector and planning context, not a universal building-assessor licence, project-vacancy count or qualification for every hydropower, pipeline, energy or conservation title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian hospitality, catering, travel and tourism training and regulation context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian hotels, restaurants, catering, accommodation, front office, housekeeping, food and beverage, travel, tours, events, recreation, tourism promotion and hospitality standards
findings: The Federal Ministry describes NIHOTOUR as Nigeria's hospitality and tourism training arm with professional and technical programmes; NTDA describes national tourism development, regulation, promotion, capacity building and accreditation of hotels, restaurants, travel agencies, tour operators and related enterprises; official sector sources identify hotel, catering, recreation, tourism safety and tourism-ethics functions.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources establish Nigerian hospitality and tourism role-family context, not a vacancy count or a universal certification for every service, food, travel or entertainment title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian inland-waterway transport, marine safety and operations context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian inland-waterway navigation, vessel operations, cargo handling, warehousing, ferry services, pilotage, safety inspection, traffic management, maritime security and intermodal transport
findings: NIWA describes statutory Nigerian responsibility for inland-waterway development and regulation, vessel operations, ferry services, cargo handling, storage, stevedoring, pilotage, vessel traffic management, safety inspections, search and rescue and maritime security; it also describes training for boat operators and skippers.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian inland-waterway role and operational context; it does not establish a counterpart for every air, rail, pipeline or ocean-shipping title, or one universal licence for every waterway role.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian rail, airport, airspace and transport-operations context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian railway stations, rail operations, train safety, signalling, route planning, airport operations, baggage, airspace and air-transport services, aviation fuel and road-transport administration
findings: NRC describes passenger and goods carriage, station management, train safety, control and signalling, route planning, traffic and commercial operations; NCAA regulates air transport, aviation fuel and aerodrome services; FAAN manages Nigerian commercial airports, airport operations, cargo and passenger services; NAMA describes air-traffic-management, communications, navigation and surveillance; the Federal Ministry of Transportation lists rail, road, engineering and transport-planning functions.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources establish Nigerian rail, airport, airspace and transport-operation context, not a vacancy count or a counterpart for every global vehicle, pipeline, event, warehouse or specialist infrastructure title.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria scaffolding supervisor and scaffolder vacancy signals
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria-based scaffolding supervision, inspection, erection, modification and dismantling work
findings: Nigeria-based EPC and construction listings identify Scaffolding Supervisor and scaffolder work involving safe erection, inspection, modification, dismantling, access planning, inventory and risk assessment; Nigerian offshore-safety course listings include scaffolding supervisor and scaffolder training.
source_summaries.limitations: The sources demonstrate a Nigerian scaffolding role family and training signal; they do not establish one universal certificate, code, employer requirement or national demand total.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian security, fire, border and correctional-service context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian fire prevention and rescue, emergency response, border security, immigration control, policing, correctional custody, probation, rehabilitation and public safety
findings: The Federal Fire Service describes fire prevention, mitigation, rescue, life and property protection, training and emergency response; NIS describes border control, surveillance, immigration compliance, airport, seaport, intelligence and cybersecurity functions; NCoS describes secure and humane custody, risk and needs assessment, rehabilitation, probation, parole and non-custodial measures; PSC/NPF materials establish Nigerian police recruitment and service context.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources support the named public-service families and functions; they do not establish a counterpart, private-security licence or vacancy count for every global guard, transport, animal, gaming or specialist rescue title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian environmental science, biodiversity, water-quality and environmental-health context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian environmental science, environmental health, biodiversity conservation, water and air quality, pollution control, environmental audit, natural resources and sustainability
findings: NESREA describes Nigerian environmental protection, biodiversity conservation, water-quality and pollution standards, environmental audits, environmental data, ecosystem conservation and research; EHCON regulates and licenses environmental-health specialists, officers, technicians and assistants; the Federal Ministry of Environment identifies chemical, waste, sewage, air-emissions and environmental-health functions.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian environmental and environmental-health practice context; it is not a national vacancy count and environmental-health registration should not be applied to every environmental scientist or ecologist.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria pipeline-engineer vacancy signals
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria-based oil-and-gas, water and infrastructure pipeline design, construction, integrity and maintenance work
findings: Nigeria-focused job postings identify Pipeline Engineer and Pipeline/Corrosion Engineer roles in Port Harcourt, Lagos and other Nigerian operations, covering design, construction, integrity, maintenance, HSE and technical monitoring.
source_summaries.limitations: The postings demonstrate local pipeline-engineering work; they do not establish one universal pipeline code, software stack, professional-registration route or demand total for every sector.

source_summaries.name: Quantity Surveyors Registration Board of Nigeria 2024 newsletter
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian quantity-surveying practice and professional registration context
findings: The QSRBN newsletter supplies Nigerian quantity-surveying professional-body context and practice material.
source_summaries.limitations: The newsletter supports professional context; specific registration gates must be shown only where the applicable rule is explicit.

source_summaries.name: Standards Organisation of Nigeria building and construction conference
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian building construction standards, structural integrity, materials, risk management and sustainable development
findings: SON reported a 2024 national conference emphasizing standards practice, structural integrity, sustainable materials and risk management in Nigeria's building and construction industry.
source_summaries.limitations: Conference and standards context does not assign one tool or credential to every construction role.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria water-engineer vacancy and recruitment signals
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria-based water, wastewater, reticulation, hydraulic and public-infrastructure engineering work
findings: Nigeria-focused recruitment and vacancy pages identify Water Engineer work involving water networks, treatment, hydraulic systems, reticulation, drainage, sewage and public or private infrastructure across Nigerian locations.
source_summaries.limitations: The sources demonstrate a Nigerian water-engineering role family and associated skills; they do not establish one universal employer requirement, professional licence or software stack.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian rail, airport, airspace and transport-operations context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian railway stations, rail operations, train safety, signalling, route planning, airport operations, baggage, airspace and air-transport services, aviation fuel and road-transport administration
findings: NRC describes passenger and goods carriage, station management, train safety, control and signalling, route planning, traffic and commercial operations; NCAA regulates air transport, aviation fuel and aerodrome services; FAAN manages Nigerian commercial airports, airport operations, cargo and passenger services; NAMA describes air-traffic-management, communications, navigation and surveillance; the Federal Ministry of Transportation lists rail, road, engineering and transport-planning functions.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources establish Nigerian rail, airport, airspace and transport-operation context, not a vacancy count or a counterpart for every global vehicle, pipeline, event, warehouse or specialist infrastructure title.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria scaffolding supervisor and scaffolder vacancy signals
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria-based scaffolding supervision, inspection, erection, modification and dismantling work
findings: Nigeria-based EPC and construction listings identify Scaffolding Supervisor and scaffolder work involving safe erection, inspection, modification, dismantling, access planning, inventory and risk assessment; Nigerian offshore-safety course listings include scaffolding supervisor and scaffolder training.
source_summaries.limitations: The sources demonstrate a Nigerian scaffolding role family and training signal; they do not establish one universal certificate, code, employer requirement or national demand total.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian security, fire, border and correctional-service context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian fire prevention and rescue, emergency response, border security, immigration control, policing, correctional custody, probation, rehabilitation and public safety
findings: The Federal Fire Service describes fire prevention, mitigation, rescue, life and property protection, training and emergency response; NIS describes border control, surveillance, immigration compliance, airport, seaport, intelligence and cybersecurity functions; NCoS describes secure and humane custody, risk and needs assessment, rehabilitation, probation, parole and non-custodial measures; PSC/NPF materials establish Nigerian police recruitment and service context.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources support the named public-service families and functions; they do not establish a counterpart, private-security licence or vacancy count for every global guard, transport, animal, gaming or specialist rescue title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian environmental science, biodiversity, water-quality and environmental-health context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian environmental science, environmental health, biodiversity conservation, water and air quality, pollution control, environmental audit, natural resources and sustainability
findings: NESREA describes Nigerian environmental protection, biodiversity conservation, water-quality and pollution standards, environmental audits, environmental data, ecosystem conservation and research; EHCON regulates and licenses environmental-health specialists, officers, technicians and assistants; the Federal Ministry of Environment identifies chemical, waste, sewage, air-emissions and environmental-health functions.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian environmental and environmental-health practice context; it is not a national vacancy count and environmental-health registration should not be applied to every environmental scientist or ecologist.

source_summaries.name: Nigeria pipeline-engineer vacancy signals
source_summaries.scope: Nigeria-based oil-and-gas, water and infrastructure pipeline design, construction, integrity and maintenance work
findings: Nigeria-focused job postings identify Pipeline Engineer and Pipeline/Corrosion Engineer roles in Port Harcourt, Lagos and other Nigerian operations, covering design, construction, integrity, maintenance, HSE and technical monitoring.
source_summaries.limitations: The postings demonstrate local pipeline-engineering work; they do not establish one universal pipeline code, software stack, professional-registration route or demand total for every sector.

source_summaries.name: Quantity Surveyors Registration Board of Nigeria 2024 newsletter

findings: The QSRBN newsletter supplies Nigerian quantity-surveying professional-body context and practice material.
source_summaries.limitations: The newsletter supports professional context; specific registration gates must be shown only where the applicable rule is explicit.

MyJobMag Nigeria feeds

source_summaries.scope: Nigerian food production, food hygiene, packaged food, storage and facility inspection
findings: NAFDAC provides food-product registration, food-hygiene, GMP, production-inspection and food-storage guidance.
The 2025 food-hygiene regulation requires appropriate education, training or experience for responsible personnel and a valid food-handlers test report for food handlers.
source_summaries.limitations: Facility, product and food-handler requirements are activity-specific; they are not a universal professional licence for every food-industry role.

findings: NBTE's current catalogue lists electrical installation maintenance and repairs, electronic system maintenance, industrial electronics, food and beverage service and hospitality pathways.
source_summaries.limitations: The standards establish training pathways, not one universal employer tool stack or a mandatory credential for every electrical, electronic or hospitality worker.

source_summaries.name: NBTE food-processing and baking National Occupational Standards
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian baking, confectionery and food-processing skills routes
findings: NBTE lists baking and confectionery National Occupational Standards and food-processing-related standards in its current NOS catalogue.

NBTE National Occupational Standards and National Skills Qualifications brochure, January 2026 edition
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian occupational and skills pathways across agriculture, animal husbandry, engineering, construction, ICT, fashion, hospitality, health and safety
findings: The brochure lists Nigerian NOS/NSQ pathways including aquaculture, crop production, animal husbandry, industrial automation, solar photovoltaic systems, welding and fabrication, garment making, food and beverage service, artificial intelligence, backend web development, cloud security engineering and other trades.
source_summaries.limitations: A listed NOS/NSQ is evidence that a Nigerian training standard exists; it is not proof that every employer requires it or that every canonical role maps one-to-one to the trade title.

source_summaries.name: NBTE National Occupational Standards and Federal TVET trade pathways
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian vocational and technical pathways including garment making, leather work, furniture and upholstery, food and beverage service, industrial automation, AI, backend web, health and safety and other occupational standards
findings: NBTE's current NOS catalogue names occupational standards and levels for garment making, leather work, furniture and upholstery, food and beverage service, industrial automation, AI, backend web and other trades.
The Federal TVET initiative describes accredited centres, practical skills, employment and entrepreneurship pathways.
source_summaries.limitations: An NOS or TVET pathway is evidence of a Nigerian training route, not a claim that every employer requires the listed level or that one trade credential is interchangeable with a degree or professional licence.

source_summaries.scope: Nigerian energy policy, planning, statistics, renewable energy, energy efficiency, electricity, fossil fuels and sustainable-energy development
findings: The Energy Commission of Nigeria identifies national energy planning and policy implementation, energy statistics, energy information systems, electricity and fossil-fuel functions, renewable-energy research and energy-efficiency or sustainable-development work.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian energy-sector and planning context, not a universal building-assessor licence, project-vacancy count or qualification for every hydropower, pipeline, energy or conservation title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian industrial automation, robotics and mechatronics training context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian industrial automation, programmable logic controllers, robotics, mechatronics, automated production, assembly, instrumentation and manufacturing technology
findings: NBTE curricula identify Nigerian training in automation and robotics, including relays, switches, contactors, machine programming, automated production lines, numerical control, automated assembly, PLC programming and fault diagnosis, robotics, mechatronics and human-machine interfaces.
source_summaries.limitations: The curricula establish a Nigerian technical-training pathway and competency categories, not evidence that every employer uses the same controller, software, machine or certification.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian petroleum operations, process safety and workforce competency context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian upstream, midstream and downstream petroleum operations, control-room work, pipeline and facility safety, competent-person training and permits
findings: NUPRC publishes Nigerian upstream regulations and facility guidelines requiring competent persons, training, safe work procedures and records.
NMDPRA publishes downstream guidelines and MISTDO safety training requirements for downstream personnel.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian petroleum operations and safety context; it does not establish a vacancy count or one credential for every operator, technician, contractor or manager title.

source_summaries.scope: Nigerian health records officers, health-information management, registration and licensure, electronic content management, digital health, EMR/EHR, data quality and confidentiality
findings: The Federal Ministry of Health describes HRORBN registration, digital compliance and health-records workforce demand, and describes ECM and national digital-health/EMR direction.
source_summaries.limitations: The regulatory requirement applies to defined health-records practice; digital-health context does not make every medical, data or administrative role a registered health-records profession.

MDCN and MLSCN Nigerian medical, dental and laboratory registration and training context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian medical and dental education, housemanship, professional registration, annual practice licensing, medical laboratory training, laboratory registration and continuing professional development
findings: MDCN publishes medical and dental education, accreditation, registration, practising-licence and CPD services.
MLSCN publishes medical-laboratory training, registration, licensure, laboratory accreditation and CPD services, including the 2025 ND curriculum.
source_summaries.limitations: The regulations apply to defined health professions and facilities; they do not establish a universal licence for every health-support, research, technology or administrative role.

Nigerian digital technology, software, AI, cybersecurity and data-protection context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian software, web, data, artificial intelligence, networking, cybersecurity, digital services, information systems, privacy and compliance work
findings: NITDA identifies digital skills, software and hardware development, cybersecurity, digital trust, research and an agile technology workforce as Nigerian strategic priorities.
NBTE lists Nigerian programmes and national occupational standards spanning software, web, data, AI, networking, robotics, computer hardware, cybersecurity and digital service operations.
NDPC describes data-protection compliance, information privacy, information audit, data management and information-security evidence relevant to Nigerian privacy and compliance work.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian technology-sector, training and regulatory context; it does not prove a specific employer requirement, salary, vacancy count or universal certificate for every ICT title.

source_summaries.scope: Nigerian university and tertiary education accreditation, academic planning, admissions, quality assurance, research, student support, curriculum and institutional administration
findings: NUC describes Nigerian university accreditation, minimum academic standards, academic planning, inspection, student services, research and institutional quality assurance; TETFund TERAS describes Nigerian tertiary research repositories and services for researchers, students and institutions; NBTE documents technical-tertiary admissions and academic-board responsibilities.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources establish Nigerian higher-education functions and regulatory context, not a universal appointment route, academic rank or credential for every teaching, coaching or training title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian hospitality, catering, travel and tourism training and regulation context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian hotels, restaurants, catering, accommodation, front office, housekeeping, food and beverage, travel, tours, events, recreation, tourism promotion and hospitality standards
findings: The Federal Ministry describes NIHOTOUR as Nigeria's hospitality and tourism training arm with professional and technical programmes; NTDA describes national tourism development, regulation, promotion, capacity building and accreditation of hotels, restaurants, travel agencies, tour operators and related enterprises; official sector sources identify hotel, catering, recreation, tourism safety and tourism-ethics functions.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources establish Nigerian hospitality and tourism role-family context, not a vacancy count or a universal certification for every service, food, travel or entertainment title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian sports development, athlete support, coaching and administration context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian athlete development, coaching, sports administration, competition, facilities, sports science, support staff and national or international sports participation

source_summaries.limitations: These sources establish Nigerian sports role and institutional context, not a vacancy count, universal coaching licence or local counterpart for every sport-specific or winter/outdoor title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian tourism, travel, hospitality accreditation and training context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian destination development, tour operations, travel consultancy, guiding, hospitality standards, tourism marketing, research, accreditation and practitioner certification

source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian tourism and hospitality context; it does not establish a vacancy count, one certificate for every travel title or a universal requirement across all employers and states.

source_summaries.scope: Nigerian cloud computing, data-centre operations, digital infrastructure, hosting, security and technical workforce development

source_summaries.name: Nigerian data engineering, cloud, software and digital-technology context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian software development, data science, data platforms, cloud computing, parallel computing, privacy, security and digital infrastructure
findings: NITDA identifies software development, data science, cloud computing and DevOps among its Nigerian technical-capacity priorities.
NITDA publishes Nigerian cloud and data-protection guidance, while the Federal Government Digital Training Academy includes software, cloud and parallel-computing tracks.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian skills, training and compliance context; it does not establish one Nigerian certificate or a vacancy count for every data, architecture or analysis title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian digital technology, software, AI, cybersecurity and data-protection context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian software, web, data, artificial intelligence, networking, cybersecurity, digital services, information systems, privacy and compliance work
findings: NITDA identifies digital skills, software and hardware development, cybersecurity, digital trust, research and an agile technology workforce as Nigerian strategic priorities.
NBTE lists Nigerian programmes and national occupational standards spanning software, web, data, AI, networking, robotics, computer hardware, cybersecurity and digital service operations.
NDPC describes data-protection compliance, information privacy, information audit, data management and information-security evidence relevant to Nigerian privacy and compliance work.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian technology-sector, training and regulatory context; it does not prove a specific employer requirement, salary, vacancy count or universal certificate for every ICT title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian electronics, computer-hardware, telecommunications and instrumentation training context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian electronic-system maintenance, computer hardware repairs, telecommunications, network cabling, instrumentation, mobile-phone repair, electrical/electronics technology and related technician work
findings: NBTE lists Nigerian technical pathways in computer-hardware repair and maintenance, electronic-system maintenance craft, industrial electronics, telecommunications equipment installation and maintenance, telecommunication technology, network cabling, mobile-phone repair, electrical/electronic engineering technology and instrumentation and control; the curricula cover diagnosis, measurement, soldering, component replacement, networking, communication systems and fault repair.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources establish Nigerian technical-training and competency context, not a vacancy count, vendor-specific tool stack or universal licence for every electronics, rail, marine, aviation or telecommunications title.

findings: Nigeria-focused MyJobMag pages identify Secretary, Executive Assistant, Confidential Secretary, Medical Secretary and Project Assistant Secretary roles across private, education, health, finance and public-facing settings.
source_summaries.limitations: The listings demonstrate Nigerian office-support role families; legal company-secretary work can require a different professional pathway and must not be conflated with general secretarial support.

source_summaries.name: National Bureau of Statistics Nigeria Labour Force Survey
NBTE National Occupational Standards and National Skills Qualifications brochure, January 2026 edition
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian occupational and skills pathways across agriculture, animal husbandry, engineering, construction, ICT, fashion, hospitality, health and safety
findings: The brochure lists Nigerian NOS/NSQ pathways including aquaculture, crop production, animal husbandry, industrial automation, solar photovoltaic systems, welding and fabrication, garment making, food and beverage service, artificial intelligence, backend web development, cloud security engineering and other trades.
source_summaries.limitations: A listed NOS/NSQ is evidence that a Nigerian training standard exists; it is not proof that every employer requires it or that every canonical role maps one-to-one to the trade title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian digital technology, software, AI, cybersecurity and data-protection context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian software, web, data, artificial intelligence, networking, cybersecurity, digital services, information systems, privacy and compliance work
findings: NITDA identifies digital skills, software and hardware development, cybersecurity, digital trust, research and an agile technology workforce as Nigerian strategic priorities.
NBTE lists Nigerian programmes and national occupational standards spanning software, web, data, AI, networking, robotics, computer hardware, cybersecurity and digital service operations.
NDPC describes data-protection compliance, information privacy, information audit, data management and information-security evidence relevant to Nigerian privacy and compliance work.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian technology-sector, training and regulatory context; it does not prove a specific employer requirement, salary, vacancy count or universal certificate for every ICT title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian higher-education teaching, administration, research and quality-assurance context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian university and tertiary education accreditation, academic planning, admissions, quality assurance, research, student support, curriculum and institutional administration
findings: NUC describes Nigerian university accreditation, minimum academic standards, academic planning, inspection, student services, research and institutional quality assurance; TETFund TERAS describes Nigerian tertiary research repositories and services for researchers, students and institutions; NBTE documents technical-tertiary admissions and academic-board responsibilities.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources establish Nigerian higher-education functions and regulatory context, not a universal appointment route, academic rank or credential for every teaching, coaching or training title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian public-service administration, integrity, privacy and compliance context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian public administration, policy, planning, public-sector compliance, anti-corruption, ethics, data protection and government records or programme work
findings: OHCSF publishes Nigerian public-service rules, policy and civil-service resources; ICPC describes review of public-body systems, anti-corruption transparency units, monitoring, reporting, ethics and compliance work in MDAs; NDPC documents data-protection compliance, audits, data-protection officers and licensed compliance organisations in Nigeria.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources establish Nigerian public-service and compliance functions; they are not evidence that every global public-office title exists locally, nor a universal qualification or vacancy count for each role.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian state and local-government office context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian state governors, local-government chairmen and councilors/councillors, local-government executive and legislative functions
findings: A Nigerian state local-government law describes the Local Government Executive Council, its Chairman as chief executive and accounting officer, Vice Chairman, Supervisors and the Legislative Council with elected or appointed councilor roles; it also refers to the Governor in the state oath and oversight context.
source_summaries.limitations: This supports Nigerian public-office counterparts and institutional functions, not a vacancy count or a universal professional qualification; 'mayor' is not treated as the canonical Nigerian title here.

findings: NIPAS publishes professional certification and examination procedures for office administration and office-technology candidates.
source_summaries.limitations: This is a professional training/membership route, not a universal statutory licence for every office administrator.

source_summaries.scope: Nigerian disease surveillance, public-health laboratories, emergency preparedness and response, field epidemiology, risk communication and health-information coordination
findings: NCDC leads prevention, detection and response to infectious-disease outbreaks and public-health emergencies in Nigeria.

source_summaries.scope: African and Nigerian retail practice, consumer behaviour, shopper marketing, selling, customer service and retail-finance training
findings: LBS describes certificate programmes for retail professionals, managers and senior executives and an Africa Retail Academy with 2024 programmes.
source_summaries.limitations: These are professional training certificates, not a statutory licence or universal hiring requirement for retail workers.

source_summaries.name: MyJobMag Nigeria feeds
National Bureau of Statistics Nigeria Labour Force Survey
Nigerian construction and building-trade occupational standards and curricula
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian masonry, painting and decoration, carpentry and joinery, construction equipment, openings, doors, windows and related building-trade training
findings: NBTE lists validated Nigerian occupational standards for masonry, painting and decoration, tiling, carpentry and joinery and construction-equipment operation; Nigerian curricula describe door and window construction, frames, materials and fixing methods; C-LMIS/CORBON publishes construction-trade standards for masonry works.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources support Nigerian occupational and training families, not a vacancy count or a claim that every named installation or supervisory title is a separate regulated occupation.

source_summaries.name: NBTE National Occupational Standards and National Skills Qualifications list
NBTE National Occupational Standards and National Skills Qualifications brochure, January 2026 edition
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian occupational and skills pathways across agriculture, animal husbandry, engineering, construction, ICT, fashion, hospitality, health and safety
findings: The brochure lists Nigerian NOS/NSQ pathways including aquaculture, crop production, animal husbandry, industrial automation, solar photovoltaic systems, welding and fabrication, garment making, food and beverage service, artificial intelligence, backend web development, cloud security engineering and other trades.
source_summaries.limitations: A listed NOS/NSQ is evidence that a Nigerian training standard exists; it is not proof that every employer requires it or that every canonical role maps one-to-one to the trade title.

source_summaries.name: National Electronic Labour Exchange Nigerian customer-service and administrative vacancy
Nigerian construction, building trades and builder-standards context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian building construction, building trades, construction skills, safety, quality, professional standards, masonry, carpentry, joinery, painting, plumbing, electrical installation, tiling and decorative stonework
findings: C-LMIS/CORBON identifies construction as a major Nigerian employer and publishes National Occupational Standards for building trades including electrical installation, carpentry and joinery, masonry, painting and decoration, plumbing, tiling and decorative stonework; CORBON describes standards, compliance, safety, sustainability, builder registration and practice-licence verification.
source_summaries.limitations: The sources support the named building-trade and builder families; they do not establish a Nigerian counterpart for every specialist engineering, transport, energy or infrastructure role in the library.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian construction-equipment operator training context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian construction-equipment operation, excavators, bulldozers, graders, loaders, concrete mixers, maintenance, workplace safety and road regulations
findings: NBTE National Skills Qualifications for Nigerian construction-equipment operations identify operator-helper and operator competencies, daily checks, equipment maintenance, health and safety, road and workplace regulations, and specific excavator, bulldozer, grader, loader and concrete-truck-mixer operation units.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian construction-equipment training context, not a vacancy count or a local counterpart for every mining, snow, cable-vehicle, elevator or specialist crane title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian hospitality, catering, travel and tourism training and regulation context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian hotels, restaurants, catering, accommodation, front office, housekeeping, food and beverage, travel, tours, events, recreation, tourism promotion and hospitality standards
findings: The Federal Ministry describes NIHOTOUR as Nigeria's hospitality and tourism training arm with professional and technical programmes; NTDA describes national tourism development, regulation, promotion, capacity building and accreditation of hotels, restaurants, travel agencies, tour operators and related enterprises; official sector sources identify hotel, catering, recreation, tourism safety and tourism-ethics functions.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources establish Nigerian hospitality and tourism role-family context, not a vacancy count or a universal certification for every service, food, travel or entertainment title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian rail, airport, airspace and transport-operations context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian railway stations, rail operations, train safety, signalling, route planning, airport operations, baggage, airspace and air-transport services, aviation fuel and road-transport administration
findings: NRC describes passenger and goods carriage, station management, train safety, control and signalling, route planning, traffic and commercial operations; NCAA regulates air transport, aviation fuel and aerodrome services; FAAN manages Nigerian commercial airports, airport operations, cargo and passenger services; NAMA describes air-traffic-management, communications, navigation and surveillance; the Federal Ministry of Transportation lists rail, road, engineering and transport-planning functions.
source_summaries.limitations: These sources establish Nigerian rail, airport, airspace and transport-operation context, not a vacancy count or a counterpart for every global vehicle, pipeline, event, warehouse or specialist infrastructure title.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian tourism, travel, hospitality accreditation and training context
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian destination development, tour operations, travel consultancy, guiding, hospitality standards, tourism marketing, research, accreditation and practitioner certification
findings: NTDA describes regulation, accreditation, classification, marketing, research, capacity building and tour-operation services across Nigeria's tourism value chain.
NIHOTOUR's registration portal describes certification and verification of hospitality, travel and tourism practitioners through a national registry.
source_summaries.limitations: This establishes Nigerian tourism and hospitality context; it does not establish a vacancy count, one certificate for every travel title or a universal requirement across all employers and states.

source_summaries.name: Nigerian retail sales consultant vacancy with customer-experience requirements
NIHOTOUR and Nigerian Tourism Development Authority practitioner registration and accreditation
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian hospitality, travel and tourism practitioner registration/certification and enterprise accreditation
findings: NIHOTOUR describes registration, certification and verification of practitioners; NTDA describes accreditation and classification of hospitality and tourism enterprises.
source_summaries.limitations: Practitioner and enterprise routes differ; neither is a universal credential for every tourism or retail role.

source_summaries.name: Standards Organisation of Nigeria tourism, travel-agency and tourism-school technical committees
University of Ilorin museum and archival certificate/diploma pathway
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian museum, archival, cultural and heritage certificate and diploma education
findings: The University of Ilorin announced 2025/2026 certificate and diploma programmes in museum and archival studies, cultural studies and creative arts.
source_summaries.limitations: An education certificate/diploma route is not a universal statutory licence or proof of demand for every heritage role.

source_summaries.name: WIPO Nigeria and Music Business Academy professional training
source_summaries.scope: Nigerian music and entertainment business training, intellectual property and employability capacity building
findings: WIPO Nigeria described a 2024/2025 Music Business Academy scholarship and a nine-month vocational programme for African music-industry professionals.
source_summaries.limitations: This supports a sector training route, not a universal music-production certification or licence.

source_summaries.scope: Nigerian building construction, building trades, construction skills, safety, quality, professional standards, masonry, carpentry, joinery, painting, plumbing, electrical installation, tiling and decorative stonework
findings: C-LMIS/CORBON identifies construction as a major Nigerian employer and publishes National Occupational Standards for building trades including electrical installation, carpentry and joinery, masonry, painting and decoration, plumbing, tiling and decorative stonework; CORBON describes standards, compliance, safety, sustainability, builder registration and practice-licence verification.
source_summaries.limitations: The sources support the named building-trade and builder families; they do not establish a Nigerian counterpart for every specialist engineering, transport, energy or infrastructure role in the library.
